Desc: When enabled, the diff editor shows arrows in its glyph margin to revert changes.

Name: diffEditor.renderSideBySide
Desc: Controls whether the diff editor shows the diff side by side or inline.

Name: diffEditor.renderSideBySideInlineBreakpoint
Desc: If the diff editor width is smaller than this value, the inline view is used.

Name: diffEditor.useInlineViewWhenSpaceIsLimited
Desc: If enabled and the editor width is too small, the inline view is used.

Name: diffEditor.wordWrap
Desc: - off: Lines will never wrap. - on: Lines will wrap at the viewport width. - inherit: Lines will wrap according to the `editor.wordWrap` setting.

Name: editor.acceptSuggestionOnCommitCharacter
Desc: Controls whether suggestions should be accepted on commit characters. For example, in JavaScript, the semi-colon (`;`) can be a commit character that accepts a suggestion and types that character.

Name: editor.acceptSuggestionOnEnter
Desc: Controls whether suggestions should be accepted on `Enter`, in addition to `Tab`. Helps to avoid ambiguity between inserting new lines or accepting suggestions. - on - smart: Only accept a suggestion with `Enter` when it makes a textual change. - off

Name: editor.accessibilityPageSize
Desc: Controls the number of lines in the editor that can be read out by a screen reader at once. When we detect a screen reader we automatically set the default to be 500. Warning: this has a performance implication for numbers larger than the default.

Name: editor.accessibilitySupport
Desc: Controls if the UI should run in a mode where it is optimized for screen readers. - auto: Use platform APIs to detect when a Screen Reader is attached. - on: Optimize for usage with a Screen Reader. - off: Assume a screen reader is not attached.

Name: editor.allowVariableFonts
Desc: Controls whether to allow using variable fonts in the editor.

Name: editor.allowVariableFontsInAccessibilityMode
Desc: Controls whether to allow using variable fonts in the editor in the accessibility mode.

Name: editor.allowVariableLineHeights
Desc: Controls whether to allow using variable line heights in the editor.

Name: editor.autoClosingBrackets
Desc: Controls whether the editor should automatically close brackets after the user adds an opening bracket. - always - languageDefined: Use language configurations to determine when to autoclose brackets. - beforeWhitespace: Autoclose brackets only when the cursor is to the left of whitespace. - never

Name: editor.autoClosingComments
Desc: Controls whether the editor should automatically close comments after the user adds an opening comment. - always - languageDefined: Use language configurations to determine when to autoclose comments. - beforeWhitespace: Autoclose comments only when the cursor is to the left of whitespace. - never

Name: editor.autoClosingDelete
Desc: Controls whether the editor should remove adjacent closing quotes or brackets when deleting. - always - auto: Remove adjacent closing quotes or brackets only if they were automatically inserted. - never

Name: editor.autoClosingOvertype
Desc: Controls whether the editor should type over closing quotes or brackets. - always - auto: Type over closing quotes or brackets only if they were automatically inserted. - never

Name: editor.autoClosingQuotes
Desc: Controls whether the editor should automatically close quotes after the user adds an opening quote. - always - languageDefined: Use language configurations to determine when to autoclose quotes. - beforeWhitespace: Autoclose quotes only when the cursor is to the left of whitespace. - never

Name: editor.autoIndent
Desc: Controls whether the editor should automatically adjust the indentation when users type, paste, move or indent lines. - none: The editor will not insert indentation automatically. - keep: The editor will keep the current line's indentation. - brackets: The editor will keep the current line's indentation and honor language defined brackets. - advanced: The editor will keep the current line's indentation, honor language defined brackets and invoke special onEnterRules defined by languages. - full: The editor will keep the current line's indentation, honor language defined brackets, invoke special onEnterRules defined by languages, and honor indentationRules defined by languages.

Name: editor.autoIndentOnPaste
Desc: Controls whether the editor should automatically auto-indent the pasted content.

Name: editor.autoIndentOnPasteWithinString
Desc: Controls whether the editor should automatically auto-indent the pasted content when pasted within a string. This takes effect when autoIndentOnPaste is true.

Name: editor.autoSurround
Desc: Controls whether the editor should automatically surround selections when typing quotes or brackets. - languageDefined: Use language configurations to determine when to automatically surround selections. - quotes: Surround with quotes but not brackets. - brackets: Surround with brackets but not quotes. - never

Name: editor.bracketPairColorization.enabled
Desc: Controls whether bracket pair colorization is enabled or not. Use `workbench.colorCustomizations` to override the bracket highlight colors.

Name: editor.bracketPairColorization.independentColorPoolPerBracketType
Desc: Controls whether each bracket type has its own independent color pool.

Name: editor.codeActions.triggerOnFocusChange
Desc: Enable triggering `editor.codeActionsOnSave` when `files.autoSave` is set to `afterDelay`. Code Actions must be set to `always` to be triggered for window and focus changes.

Name: editor.codeActionsOnSave
Desc: Run Code Actions for the editor on save. Code Actions must be specified and the editor must not be shutting down. When `files.autoSave` is set to `afterDelay`, Code Actions will only be run when the file is saved explicitly. Example: `"source.organizeImports": "explicit" `

Name: editor.codeActionWidget.includeNearbyQuickFixes
Desc: Enable/disable showing nearest Quick Fix within a line when not currently on a diagnostic.

Name: editor.codeActionWidget.showHeaders
Desc: Enable/disable showing group headers in the Code Action menu.

Name: editor.codeLens
Desc: Controls whether the editor shows CodeLens.

Name: editor.codeLensFontFamily
Desc: Controls the font family for CodeLens.

Name: editor.codeLensFontSize
Desc: Controls the font size in pixels for CodeLens. When set to 0, 90% of `editor.fontSize` is used.

Name: editor.colorDecorators
Desc: Controls whether the editor should render the inline color decorators and color picker.

Name: editor.colorDecoratorsActivatedOn
Desc: Controls the condition to make a color picker appear from a color decorator. - clickAndHover: Make the color picker appear both on click and hover of the color decorator - hover: Make the color picker appear on hover of the color decorator - click: Make the color picker appear on click of the color decorator

Name: editor.colorDecoratorsLimit
Desc: Controls the max number of color decorators that can be rendered in an editor at once.

Name: editor.columnSelection
Desc: Enable that the selection with the mouse and keys is doing column selection.

Name: editor.comments.ignoreEmptyLines
Desc: Controls if empty lines should be ignored with toggle, add or remove actions for line comments.

Name: editor.comments.insertSpace
Desc: Controls whether a space character is inserted when commenting.

Name: editor.copyWithSyntaxHighlighting
Desc: Controls whether syntax highlighting should be copied into the clipboard.

Name: editor.cursorBlinking
Desc: Control the cursor animation style.

Name: editor.cursorHeight
Desc: Controls the height of the cursor when `editor.cursorStyle` is set to `line`. Cursor's max height depends on line height.

Name: editor.cursorSmoothCaretAnimation
Desc: Controls whether the smooth caret animation should be enabled. - off: Smooth caret animation is disabled. - explicit: Smooth caret animation is enabled only when the user moves the cursor with an explicit gesture. - on: Smooth caret animation is always enabled.

Name: editor.cursorStyle
Desc: Controls the cursor style in insert input mode.

Name: editor.cursorSurroundingLines
Desc: Controls the minimal number of visible leading lines (minimum 0) and trailing lines (minimum 1) surrounding the cursor. Known as 'scrollOff' or 'scrollOffset' in some other editors.

Name: editor.cursorSurroundingLinesStyle
Desc: Controls when `editor.cursorSurroundingLines` should be enforced. - default: `cursorSurroundingLines` is enforced only when triggered via the keyboard or API. - all: `cursorSurroundingLines` is enforced always.

Name: editor.cursorWidth
Desc: Controls the width of the cursor when `editor.cursorStyle` is set to `line`.

Name: editor.defaultColorDecorators
Desc: Controls whether inline color decorations should be shown using the default document color provider. - auto: Show default color decorators only when no extension provides colors decorators. - always: Always show default color decorators. - never: Never show default color decorators.

Name: editor.defaultFoldingRangeProvider
Desc: Defines a default folding range provider that takes precedence over all other folding range providers. Must be the identifier of an extension contributing a folding range provider.

Name: editor.defaultFormatter
Desc: Defines a default formatter which takes precedence over all other formatter settings. Must be the identifier of an extension contributing a formatter.

Name: editor.definitionLinkOpensInPeek
Desc: Controls whether the Go to Definition mouse gesture always opens the peek widget.

Name: editor.detectIndentation
Desc: Controls whether `editor.tabSize` and `editor.insertSpaces` will be automatically detected when a file is opened based on the file contents.

Name: editor.doubleClickSelectsBlock
Desc: Controls whether double-clicking next to a bracket or quote selects the content inside.

Name: editor.dragAndDrop
Desc: Controls whether the editor should allow moving selections via drag and drop.

Name: editor.dropIntoEditor.enabled
Desc: Controls whether you can drag and drop a file into a text editor by holding down the `Shift` key (instead of opening the file in an editor).

Name: editor.dropIntoEditor.preferences
Desc: Configures the preferred type of edit to use when dropping content. This is an ordered list of edit kinds. The first available edit of a preferred kind will be used.

Name: editor.dropIntoEditor.showDropSelector
Desc: Controls if a widget is shown when dropping files into the editor. This widget lets you control how the file is dropped. - afterDrop: Show the drop selector widget after a file is dropped into the editor. - never: Never show the drop selector widget. Instead the default drop provider is always used.

Name: editor.editContext
Desc: Sets whether the EditContext API should be used instead of the text area to power input in the editor.

Name: editor.emptySelectionClipboard
Desc: Controls whether copying without a selection copies the current line.

Name: editor.experimental.asyncTokenization
Desc: Controls whether the tokenization should happen asynchronously on a web worker.

Name: editor.experimental.asyncTokenizationLogging
Desc: Controls whether async tokenization should be logged. For debugging only.

Name: editor.experimental.asyncTokenizationVerification
Desc: Controls whether async tokenization should be verified against legacy background tokenization. Might slow down tokenization. For debugging only.

Name: editor.experimental.preferTreeSitter.css
Desc: Controls whether tree sitter parsing should be turned on for css. This will take precedence over `editor.experimental.treeSitterTelemetry` for css.

Name: editor.experimental.preferTreeSitter.ini
Desc: Controls whether tree sitter parsing should be turned on for ini. This will take precedence over `editor.experimental.treeSitterTelemetry` for ini.

Name: editor.experimental.preferTreeSitter.regex
Desc: Controls whether tree sitter parsing should be turned on for regex. This will take precedence over `editor.experimental.treeSitterTelemetry` for regex.

Name: editor.experimental.preferTreeSitter.typescript
Desc: Controls whether tree sitter parsing should be turned on for typescript. This will take precedence over `editor.experimental.treeSitterTelemetry` for typescript.

Name: editor.experimental.treeSitterTelemetry
Desc: Controls whether tree sitter parsing should be turned on and telemetry collected. Setting `editor.experimental.preferTreeSitter` for specific languages will take precedence.

Name: editor.experimentalGpuAcceleration
Desc: Controls whether to use the experimental GPU acceleration to render the editor. - off: Use regular DOM-based rendering. - on: Use GPU acceleration.

Name: editor.experimentalWhitespaceRendering
Desc: Controls whether whitespace is rendered with a new, experimental method. - svg: Use a new rendering method with svgs. - font: Use a new rendering method with font characters. - off: Use the stable rendering method.

Name: editor.fastScrollSensitivity
Desc: Scrolling speed multiplier when pressing `Alt`.

Name: editor.find.addExtraSpaceOnTop
Desc: Controls whether the Find Widget should add extra lines on top of the editor. When true, you can scroll beyond the first line when the Find Widget is visible.

Name: editor.find.autoFindInSelection
Desc: Controls the condition for turning on Find in Selection automatically. - never: Never turn on Find in Selection automatically (default). - always: Always turn on Find in Selection automatically. - multiline: Turn on Find in Selection automatically when multiple lines of content are selected.

Name: editor.find.closeOnResult
Desc: Controls whether the Find Widget closes after an explicit find navigation command lands on a result.

Name: editor.find.cursorMoveOnType
Desc: Controls whether the cursor should jump to find matches while typing.

Name: editor.find.findOnType
Desc: Controls whether the Find Widget should search as you type.

Name: editor.find.history
Desc: Controls how the find widget history should be stored - never: Do not store search history from the find widget. - workspace: Store search history across the active workspace

Name: editor.find.loop
Desc: Controls whether the search automatically restarts from the beginning (or the end) when no further matches can be found.

Name: editor.find.replaceHistory
Desc: Controls how the replace widget history should be stored - never: Do not store history from the replace widget. - workspace: Store replace history across the active workspace

Name: editor.find.seedSearchStringFromSelection
Desc: Controls whether the search string in the Find Widget is seeded from the editor selection. - never: Never seed search string from the editor selection. - always: Always seed search string from the editor selection, including word at cursor position. - selection: Only seed search string from the editor selection.

Name: editor.folding
Desc: Controls whether the editor has code folding enabled.

Name: editor.foldingHighlight
Desc: Controls whether the editor should highlight folded ranges.

Name: editor.foldingImportsByDefault
Desc: Controls whether the editor automatically collapses import ranges.

Name: editor.foldingMaximumRegions
Desc: The maximum number of foldable regions. Increasing this value may result in the editor becoming less responsive when the current source has a large number of foldable regions.

Name: editor.foldingStrategy
Desc: Controls the strategy for computing folding ranges. - auto: Use a language-specific folding strategy if available, else the indentation-based one. - indentation: Use the indentation-based folding strategy.

Name: editor.fontFamily
Desc: Controls the font family.

Name: editor.fontLigatures
Desc: Configures font ligatures or font features. Can be either a boolean to enable/disable ligatures or a string for the value of the CSS 'font-feature-settings' property.

Name: editor.fontSize
Desc: Controls the font size in pixels.

Name: editor.fontVariations
Desc: Configures font variations. Can be either a boolean to enable/disable the translation from font-weight to font-variation-settings or a string for the value of the CSS 'font-variation-settings' property.

Name: editor.fontWeight
Desc: Controls the font weight. Accepts "normal" and "bold" keywords or numbers between 1 and 1000.

Name: editor.formatOnPaste
Desc: Controls whether the editor should automatically format the pasted content. A formatter must be available and the formatter should be able to format a range in a document.

Name: editor.formatOnSave
Desc: Format a file on save. A formatter must be available and the editor must not be shutting down. When `files.autoSave` is set to `afterDelay`, the file will only be formatted when saved explicitly.

Name: editor.formatOnSaveMode
Desc: Controls if format on save formats the whole file or only modifications. Only applies when `editor.formatOnSave` is enabled. - file: Format the whole file. - modifications: Format modifications. Requires source control and a formatter that supports 'Format Selection'. - modificationsIfAvailable: Will attempt to format modifications only (requires source control and a formatter that supports 'Format Selection'). If source control can't be used, then the whole file will be formatted.

Name: editor.formatOnType
Desc: Controls whether the editor should automatically format the line after typing.

Name: editor.glyphMargin
Desc: Controls whether the editor should render the vertical glyph margin. Glyph margin is mostly used for debugging.

Name: editor.gotoLocation.alternativeDeclarationCommand
Desc: Alternative command id that is being executed when the result of 'Go to Declaration' is the current location.

Name: editor.gotoLocation.alternativeDefinitionCommand
Desc: Alternative command id that is being executed when the result of 'Go to Definition' is the current location.

Name: editor.gotoLocation.alternativeImplementationCommand
Desc: Alternative command id that is being executed when the result of 'Go to Implementation' is the current location.

Name: editor.gotoLocation.alternativeReferenceCommand
Desc: Alternative command id that is being executed when the result of 'Go to Reference' is the current location.

Name: editor.gotoLocation.alternativeTypeDefinitionCommand
Desc: Alternative command id that is being executed when the result of 'Go to Type Definition' is the current location.

Name: editor.gotoLocation.multiple
Desc: This setting is deprecated, please use separate settings like 'editor.editor.gotoLocation.multipleDefinitions' or 'editor.editor.gotoLocation.multipleImplementations' instead.

Name: editor.gotoLocation.multipleDeclarations
Desc: Controls the behavior the 'Go to Declaration'-command when multiple target locations exist. - peek: Show Peek view of the results (default) - gotoAndPeek: Go to the primary result and show a Peek view - goto: Go to the primary result and enable Peek-less navigation to others

Name: editor.gotoLocation.multipleDefinitions
Desc: Controls the behavior the 'Go to Definition'-command when multiple target locations exist. - peek: Show Peek view of the results (default) - gotoAndPeek: Go to the primary result and show a Peek view - goto: Go to the primary result and enable Peek-less navigation to others

Name: editor.gotoLocation.multipleImplementations
Desc: Controls the behavior the 'Go to Implementations'-command when multiple target locations exist. - peek: Show Peek view of the results (default) - gotoAndPeek: Go to the primary result and show a Peek view - goto: Go to the primary result and enable Peek-less navigation to others

Name: editor.gotoLocation.multipleReferences
Desc: Controls the behavior the 'Go to References'-command when multiple target locations exist. - peek: Show Peek view of the results (default) - gotoAndPeek: Go to the primary result and show a Peek view - goto: Go to the primary result and enable Peek-less navigation to others

Name: editor.gotoLocation.multipleTypeDefinitions
Desc: Controls the behavior the 'Go to Type Definition'-command when multiple target locations exist. - peek: Show Peek view of the results (default) - gotoAndPeek: Go to the primary result and show a Peek view - goto: Go to the primary result and enable Peek-less navigation to others

Name: editor.guides.bracketPairs
Desc: Controls whether bracket pair guides are enabled or not. - true: Enables bracket pair guides. - active: Enables bracket pair guides only for the active bracket pair. - false: Disables bracket pair guides.

Name: editor.guides.bracketPairsHorizontal
Desc: Controls whether horizontal bracket pair guides are enabled or not. - true: Enables horizontal guides as addition to vertical bracket pair guides. - active: Enables horizontal guides only for the active bracket pair. - false: Disables horizontal bracket pair guides.

Name: editor.guides.highlightActiveBracketPair
Desc: Controls whether the editor should highlight the active bracket pair.

Name: editor.guides.highlightActiveIndentation
Desc: Controls whether the editor should highlight the active indent guide. - true: Highlights the active indent guide. - always: Highlights the active indent guide even if bracket guides are highlighted. - false: Do not highlight the active indent guide.

Name: editor.guides.indentation
Desc: Controls whether the editor should render indent guides.

Name: editor.hideCursorInOverviewRuler
Desc: Controls whether the cursor should be hidden in the overview ruler.

Name: editor.hover.above
Desc: Prefer showing hovers above the line, if there's space.

Name: editor.hover.delay
Desc: Controls the delay in milliseconds after which the hover is shown.

Name: editor.hover.enabled
Desc: Controls whether the hover is shown. - on: Hover is enabled. - off: Hover is disabled. - onKeyboardModifier: Hover is shown when holding `Control` or `Alt` (the opposite modifier of `editor.multiCursorModifier`)

Name: editor.hover.hidingDelay
Desc: Controls the delay in milliseconds after which the hover is hidden. Requires `editor.hover.sticky` to be enabled.

Name: editor.hover.showLongLineWarning
Desc: Controls whether long line warning hovers are shown, such as when tokenization is skipped or rendering is paused.

Name: editor.hover.sticky
Desc: Controls whether the hover should remain visible when mouse is moved over it.

Name: editor.indentSize
Desc: The number of spaces used for indentation or `"tabSize"` to use the value from `editor.tabSize`. This setting is overridden based on the file contents when `editor.detectIndentation` is on.

Name: editor.inertialScroll
Desc: Make scrolling inertial - mostly useful with touchpad on linux.

Name: editor.inlayHints.enabled
Desc: Enables the inlay hints in the editor. - on: Inlay hints are enabled - onUnlessPressed: Inlay hints are showing by default and hide when holding Ctrl+Alt - offUnlessPressed: Inlay hints are hidden by default and show when holding Ctrl+Alt - off: Inlay hints are disabled

Name: editor.inlayHints.fontFamily
Desc: Controls font family of inlay hints in the editor. When set to empty, the `editor.fontFamily` is used.

Name: editor.inlayHints.fontSize
Desc: Controls font size of inlay hints in the editor. As default the `editor.fontSize` is used when the configured value is less than `5` or greater than the editor font size.

Name: editor.inlayHints.maximumLength
Desc: Maximum overall length of inlay hints, for a single line, before they get truncated by the editor. Set to `0` to never truncate

Name: editor.inlayHints.padding
Desc: Enables the padding around the inlay hints in the editor.

Name: editor.inlineCompletionsAccessibilityVerbose
Desc: Controls whether the accessibility hint should be provided to screen reader users when an inline completion is shown.

Name: editor.inlineSuggest.edits.allowCodeShifting
Desc: Controls whether showing a suggestion will shift the code to make space for the suggestion inline.

Name: editor.inlineSuggest.edits.longDistanceHintContextLineCount
Desc: Controls how many lines of surrounding context are shown above and below the target line in the long distance inline suggestion preview. Set to 0 to only show the target line.

Name: editor.inlineSuggest.edits.renderSideBySide
Desc: Controls whether larger suggestions can be shown side by side. - auto: Larger suggestions will show side by side if there is enough space, otherwise they will be shown below. - never: Larger suggestions are never shown side by side and will always be shown below.

Name: editor.inlineSuggest.edits.showCollapsed
Desc: Controls whether the suggestion will show as collapsed until jumping to it.

Name: editor.inlineSuggest.edits.showLongDistanceHint
Desc: Controls whether long distance inline suggestions are shown.

Name: editor.inlineSuggest.enabled
Desc: Controls whether to automatically show inline suggestions in the editor.

Name: editor.inlineSuggest.experimental.emptyResponseInformation
Desc: Controls whether to send request information from the inline suggestion provider.

Name: editor.inlineSuggest.experimental.showOnSuggestConflict
Desc: Controls whether to show inline suggestions when there is a suggest conflict.

Name: editor.inlineSuggest.experimental.suppressInlineSuggestions
Desc: Suppresses inline completions for specified extension IDs -- comma separated.

Name: editor.inlineSuggest.fontFamily
Desc: Controls the font family of the inline suggestions.

Name: editor.inlineSuggest.minShowDelay
Desc: Controls the minimal delay in milliseconds after which inline suggestions are shown after typing.

Name: editor.inlineSuggest.showToolbar
Desc: Controls when to show the inline suggestion toolbar. - always: Show the inline suggestion toolbar whenever an inline suggestion is shown. - onHover: Show the inline suggestion toolbar when hovering over an inline suggestion. - never: Never show the inline suggestion toolbar.

Name: editor.inlineSuggest.suppressInSnippetMode
Desc: Controls whether inline suggestions are suppressed when in snippet mode.

Name: editor.inlineSuggest.suppressSuggestions
Desc: Controls how inline suggestions interact with the suggest widget. If enabled, the suggest widget is not shown automatically when inline suggestions are available.

Name: editor.inlineSuggest.syntaxHighlightingEnabled
Desc: Controls whether to show syntax highlighting for inline suggestions in the editor.

Name: editor.inlineSuggest.triggerCommandOnProviderChange
Desc: Controls whether to trigger a command when the inline suggestion provider changes.

Name: editor.insertSpaces
Desc: Insert spaces when pressing `Tab`. This setting is overridden based on the file contents when `editor.detectIndentation` is on.

Name: editor.language.brackets
Desc: Defines the bracket symbols that increase or decrease the indentation.

Name: editor.language.colorizedBracketPairs
Desc: Defines the bracket pairs that are colorized by their nesting level if bracket pair colorization is enabled.

Name: editor.largeFileOptimizations
Desc: Special handling for large files to disable certain memory intensive features.

Name: editor.letterSpacing
Desc: Controls the letter spacing in pixels.

Name: editor.lightbulb.enabled
Desc: Enables the Code Action lightbulb in the editor. - off: Disable the code action menu. - onCode: Show the code action menu when the cursor is on lines with code. - on: Show the code action menu when the cursor is on lines with code or on empty lines.

Name: editor.lineHeight
Desc: Controls the line height. - Use 0 to automatically compute the line height from the font size. - Values between 0 and 8 will be used as a multiplier with the font size. - Values greater than or equal to 8 will be used as effective values.

Name: editor.lineNumbers
Desc: Controls the display of line numbers. - off: Line numbers are not rendered. - on: Line numbers are rendered as absolute number. - relative: Line numbers are rendered as distance in lines to cursor position. - interval: Line numbers are rendered every 10 lines.

Name: editor.linkedEditing
Desc: Controls whether the editor has linked editing enabled. Depending on the language, related symbols such as HTML tags, are updated while editing.

Name: editor.links
Desc: Controls whether the editor should detect links and make them clickable.

Name: editor.matchBrackets
Desc: Highlight matching brackets.

Name: editor.maxTokenizationLineLength
Desc: Lines above this length will not be tokenized for performance reasons

Name: editor.minimap.autohide
Desc: Controls whether the minimap is hidden automatically. - none: The minimap is always shown. - mouseover: The minimap is hidden when mouse is not over the minimap and shown when mouse is over the minimap. - scroll: The minimap is only shown when the editor is scrolled

Name: editor.minimap.enabled
Desc: Controls whether the minimap is shown.

Name: editor.minimap.markSectionHeaderRegex
Desc: Defines the regular expression used to find section headers in comments. The regex must contain a named match group `label` (written as `(?<label>.+)`) that encapsulates the section header, otherwise it will not work. Optionally you can include another match group named `separator`. Use \n in the pattern to match multi-line headers.

Name: editor.minimap.maxColumn
Desc: Limit the width of the minimap to render at most a certain number of columns.

Name: editor.minimap.renderCharacters
Desc: Render the actual characters on a line as opposed to color blocks.

Name: editor.minimap.scale
Desc: Scale of content drawn in the minimap: 1, 2 or 3.

Name: editor.minimap.sectionHeaderFontSize
Desc: Controls the font size of section headers in the minimap.

Name: editor.minimap.sectionHeaderLetterSpacing
Desc: Controls the amount of space (in pixels) between characters of section header. This helps the readability of the header in small font sizes.

Name: editor.minimap.showMarkSectionHeaders
Desc: Controls whether MARK: comments are shown as section headers in the minimap.

Name: editor.minimap.showRegionSectionHeaders
Desc: Controls whether named regions are shown as section headers in the minimap.

Name: editor.minimap.showSlider
Desc: Controls when the minimap slider is shown.

Name: editor.minimap.side
Desc: Controls the side where to render the minimap.

Name: editor.minimap.size
Desc: Controls the size of the minimap. - proportional: The minimap has the same size as the editor contents (and might scroll). - fill: The minimap will stretch or shrink as necessary to fill the height of the editor (no scrolling). - fit: The minimap will shrink as necessary to never be larger than the editor (no scrolling).

Name: editor.mouseMiddleClickAction
Desc: Controls what happens when middle mouse button is clicked in the editor.

Name: editor.mouseWheelScrollSensitivity
Desc: A multiplier to be used on the `deltaX` and `deltaY` of mouse wheel scroll events.

Name: editor.mouseWheelZoom
Desc: Zoom the font of the editor when using mouse wheel and holding `Ctrl`.

Name: editor.multiCursorLimit
Desc: Controls the max number of cursors that can be in an active editor at once.

Name: editor.multiCursorMergeOverlapping
Desc: Merge multiple cursors when they are overlapping.

Name: editor.multiCursorModifier
Desc: The modifier to be used to add multiple cursors with the mouse. The Go to Definition and Open Link mouse gestures will adapt such that they do not conflict with the [multicursor modifier](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/editor/codebasics#_multicursor-modifier). - ctrlCmd: Maps to `Control` on Windows and Linux and to `Command` on macOS. - alt: Maps to `Alt` on Windows and Linux and to `Option` on macOS.

Name: editor.multiCursorPaste
Desc: Controls pasting when the line count of the pasted text matches the cursor count. - spread: Each cursor pastes a single line of the text. - full: Each cursor pastes the full text.

Name: editor.occurrencesHighlight
Desc: Controls whether occurrences should be highlighted across open files. - off: Does not highlight occurrences. - singleFile: Highlights occurrences only in the current file. - multiFile: Experimental: Highlights occurrences across all valid open files.

Name: editor.occurrencesHighlightDelay
Desc: Controls the delay in milliseconds after which occurrences are highlighted.

Name: editor.overtypeCursorStyle
Desc: Controls the cursor style in overtype input mode.

Name: editor.overtypeOnPaste
Desc: Controls whether pasting should overtype.

Name: editor.overviewRulerBorder
Desc: Controls whether a border should be drawn around the overview ruler.

Name: editor.padding.bottom
Desc: Controls the amount of space between the bottom edge of the editor and the last line.

Name: editor.padding.top
Desc: Controls the amount of space between the top edge of the editor and the first line.

Name: editor.parameterHints.cycle
Desc: Controls whether the parameter hints menu cycles or closes when reaching the end of the list.

Name: editor.parameterHints.enabled
Desc: Enables a pop-up that shows parameter documentation and type information as you type.

Name: editor.pasteAs.enabled
Desc: Controls whether you can paste content in different ways.

Name: editor.pasteAs.preferences
Desc: Configures the preferred type of edit to use when pasting content. This is an ordered list of edit kinds. The first available edit of a preferred kind will be used.

Name: editor.pasteAs.showPasteSelector
Desc: Controls if a widget is shown when pasting content in to the editor. This widget lets you control how the file is pasted. - afterPaste: Show the paste selector widget after content is pasted into the editor. - never: Never show the paste selector widget. Instead the default pasting behavior is always used.

Name: editor.peekWidgetDefaultFocus
Desc: Controls whether to focus the inline editor or the tree in the peek widget. - tree: Focus the tree when opening peek - editor: Focus the editor when opening peek

Name: editor.quickSuggestions
Desc: Controls whether suggestions should automatically show up while typing. This can be controlled for typing in comments, strings, and other code. Quick suggestion can be configured to show as ghost text or with the suggest widget. Also be aware of the `editor.suggestOnTriggerCharacters`-setting which controls if suggestions are triggered by special characters.

Name: editor.quickSuggestionsDelay
Desc: Controls the delay in milliseconds after which quick suggestions will show up.

Name: editor.renameOnType
Desc: Deprecated, use `editor.linkedEditing` instead. Controls whether the editor auto renames on type.

Name: editor.renderControlCharacters
Desc: Controls whether the editor should render control characters.

Name: editor.renderFinalNewline
Desc: Render last line number when the file ends with a newline.

Name: editor.renderLineHighlight
Desc: Controls how the editor should render the current line highlight. - none - gutter - line - all: Highlights both the gutter and the current line.

Name: editor.renderLineHighlightOnlyWhenFocus
Desc: Controls if the editor should render the current line highlight only when the editor is focused.

Name: editor.renderRichScreenReaderContent
Desc: Whether to render rich screen reader content when the `editor.editContext` setting is enabled.

Name: editor.renderWhitespace
Desc: Controls how the editor should render whitespace characters. - none - boundary: Render whitespace characters except for single spaces between words. - selection: Render whitespace characters only on selected text. - trailing: Render only trailing whitespace characters. - all

Name: editor.roundedSelection
Desc: Controls whether selections should have rounded corners.

Name: editor.rulers
Desc: Render vertical rulers after a certain number of monospace characters. Use multiple values for multiple rulers. No rulers are drawn if array is empty.

Name: editor.screenReaderAnnounceInlineSuggestion
Desc: Control whether inline suggestions are announced by a screen reader.

Name: editor.scrollbar.horizontal
Desc: Controls the visibility of the horizontal scrollbar. - auto: The horizontal scrollbar will be visible only when necessary. - visible: The horizontal scrollbar will always be visible. - hidden: The horizontal scrollbar will always be hidden.

Name: editor.scrollbar.horizontalScrollbarSize
Desc: The height of the horizontal scrollbar.

Name: editor.scrollbar.ignoreHorizontalScrollbarInContentHeight
Desc: When set, the horizontal scrollbar will not increase the size of the editor's content.

Name: editor.scrollbar.scrollByPage
Desc: Controls whether clicks scroll by page or jump to click position.

Name: editor.scrollbar.vertical
Desc: Controls the visibility of the vertical scrollbar. - auto: The vertical scrollbar will be visible only when necessary. - visible: The vertical scrollbar will always be visible. - hidden: The vertical scrollbar will always be hidden.

Name: editor.scrollbar.verticalScrollbarSize
Desc: The width of the vertical scrollbar.

Name: editor.scrollBeyondLastColumn
Desc: Controls the number of extra characters beyond which the editor will scroll horizontally.

Name: editor.scrollBeyondLastLine
Desc: Controls whether the editor will scroll beyond the last line.

Name: editor.scrollOnMiddleClick
Desc: Controls whether the editor will scroll when the middle button is pressed.

Name: editor.scrollPredominantAxis
Desc: Scroll only along the predominant axis when scrolling both vertically and horizontally at the same time. Prevents horizontal drift when scrolling vertically on a trackpad.

Name: editor.selectionClipboard
Desc: Controls whether the Linux primary clipboard should be supported.

Name: editor.selectionHighlight
Desc: Controls whether the editor should highlight matches similar to the selection.

Name: editor.selectionHighlightMaxLength
Desc: Controls how many characters can be in the selection before similar matches are not highlighted. Set to zero for unlimited.

Name: editor.selectionHighlightMultiline
Desc: Controls whether the editor should highlight selection matches that span multiple lines.

Name: editor.semanticHighlighting.enabled
Desc: Controls whether the semanticHighlighting is shown for the languages that support it. - true: Semantic highlighting enabled for all color themes. - false: Semantic highlighting disabled for all color themes. - configuredByTheme: Semantic highlighting is configured by the current color theme's `semanticHighlighting` setting.

Name: editor.showDeprecated
Desc: Controls strikethrough deprecated variables.

Name: editor.showFoldingControls
Desc: Controls when the folding controls on the gutter are shown. - always: Always show the folding controls. - never: Never show the folding controls and reduce the gutter size. - mouseover: Only show the folding controls when the mouse is over the gutter.

Name: editor.showUnused
Desc: Controls fading out of unused code.

Name: editor.smartSelect.selectLeadingAndTrailingWhitespace
Desc: Whether leading and trailing whitespace should always be selected.

Name: editor.smartSelect.selectSubwords
Desc: Whether subwords (like 'foo' in 'fooBar' or 'foo_bar') should be selected.

Name: editor.smoothScrolling
Desc: Controls whether the editor will scroll using an animation.

Name: editor.snippets.codeActions.enabled
Desc: Controls if surround-with-snippets or file template snippets show as Code Actions.

Name: editor.snippetSuggestions
Desc: Controls whether snippets are shown with other suggestions and how they are sorted. - top: Show snippet suggestions on top of other suggestions. - bottom: Show snippet suggestions below other suggestions. - inline: Show snippets suggestions with other suggestions. - none: Do not show snippet suggestions.

Name: editor.stablePeek
Desc: Keep peek editors open even when double-clicking their content or when hitting `Escape`.

Name: editor.stickyScroll.defaultModel
Desc: Defines the model to use for determining which lines to stick. If the outline model does not exist, it will fall back on the folding provider model which falls back on the indentation model. This order is respected in all three cases.

Name: editor.stickyScroll.enabled
Desc: Shows the nested current scopes during the scroll at the top of the editor.

Name: editor.stickyScroll.maxLineCount
Desc: Defines the maximum number of sticky lines to show.

Name: editor.stickyScroll.scrollWithEditor
Desc: Enable scrolling of Sticky Scroll with the editor's horizontal scrollbar.

Name: editor.stickyTabStops
Desc: Emulate selection behavior of tab characters when using spaces for indentation. Selection will stick to tab stops.

Name: editor.suggest.filteredTypes
Desc: This setting is deprecated, please use separate settings like 'editor.suggest.showKeywords' or 'editor.suggest.showSnippets' instead.

Name: editor.suggest.filterGraceful
Desc: Controls whether filtering and sorting suggestions accounts for small typos.

Name: editor.suggest.insertMode
Desc: Controls whether words are overwritten when accepting completions. Note that this depends on extensions opting into this feature. - insert: Insert suggestion without overwriting text right of the cursor. - replace: Insert suggestion and overwrite text right of the cursor.

Name: editor.suggest.localityBonus
Desc: Controls whether sorting favors words that appear close to the cursor.

Name: editor.suggest.matchOnWordStartOnly
Desc: When enabled IntelliSense filtering requires that the first character matches on a word start. For example, `c` on `Console` or `WebContext` but _not_ on `description`. When disabled IntelliSense will show more results but still sorts them by match quality.

Name: editor.suggest.preview
Desc: Controls whether to preview the suggestion outcome in the editor.

Name: editor.suggest.selectionMode
Desc: Controls whether a suggestion is selected when the widget shows. Note that this only applies to automatically triggered suggestions (`editor.quickSuggestions` and `editor.suggestOnTriggerCharacters`) and that a suggestion is always selected when explicitly invoked, e.g via `Ctrl+Space`. - always: Always select a suggestion when automatically triggering IntelliSense. - never: Never select a suggestion when automatically triggering IntelliSense. - whenTriggerCharacter: Select a suggestion only when triggering IntelliSense from a trigger character. - whenQuickSuggestion: Select a suggestion only when triggering IntelliSense as you type.

Name: editor.suggest.shareSuggestSelections
Desc: Controls whether remembered suggestion selections are shared between multiple workspaces and windows (needs `editor.suggestSelection`).

Name: editor.suggest.showClasses
Desc: When enabled IntelliSense shows `class`-suggestions.

Name: editor.suggest.showColors
Desc: When enabled IntelliSense shows `color`-suggestions.

Name: editor.suggest.showConstants
Desc: When enabled IntelliSense shows `constant`-suggestions.

Name: editor.suggest.showConstructors
Desc: When enabled IntelliSense shows `constructor`-suggestions.

Name: editor.suggest.showCustomcolors
Desc: When enabled IntelliSense shows `customcolor`-suggestions.

Name: editor.suggest.showDeprecated
Desc: When enabled IntelliSense shows `deprecated`-suggestions.

Name: editor.suggest.showEnumMembers
Desc: When enabled IntelliSense shows `enumMember`-suggestions.

Name: editor.suggest.showEnums
Desc: When enabled IntelliSense shows `enum`-suggestions.

Name: editor.suggest.showEvents
Desc: When enabled IntelliSense shows `event`-suggestions.

Name: editor.suggest.showFields
Desc: When enabled IntelliSense shows `field`-suggestions.

Name: editor.suggest.showFiles
Desc: When enabled IntelliSense shows `file`-suggestions.

Name: editor.suggest.showFolders
Desc: When enabled IntelliSense shows `folder`-suggestions.

Name: editor.suggest.showFunctions
Desc: When enabled IntelliSense shows `function`-suggestions.

Name: editor.suggest.showIcons
Desc: Controls whether to show or hide icons in suggestions.

Name: editor.suggest.showInlineDetails
Desc: Controls whether suggest details show inline with the label or only in the details widget.

Name: editor.suggest.showInterfaces
Desc: When enabled IntelliSense shows `interface`-suggestions.

Name: editor.suggest.showIssues
Desc: When enabled IntelliSense shows `issues`-suggestions.

Name: editor.suggest.showKeywords
Desc: When enabled IntelliSense shows `keyword`-suggestions.

Name: editor.suggest.showMethods
Desc: When enabled IntelliSense shows `method`-suggestions.

Name: editor.suggest.showModules
Desc: When enabled IntelliSense shows `module`-suggestions.

Name: editor.suggest.showOperators
Desc: When enabled IntelliSense shows `operator`-suggestions.

Name: editor.suggest.showProperties
Desc: When enabled IntelliSense shows `property`-suggestions.

Name: editor.suggest.showReferences
Desc: When enabled IntelliSense shows `reference`-suggestions.

Name: editor.suggest.showSnippets
Desc: When enabled IntelliSense shows `snippet`-suggestions.

Name: editor.suggest.showStatusBar
Desc: Controls the visibility of the status bar at the bottom of the suggest widget.

Name: editor.suggest.showStructs
Desc: When enabled IntelliSense shows `struct`-suggestions.

Name: editor.suggest.showTypeParameters
Desc: When enabled IntelliSense shows `typeParameter`-suggestions.

Name: editor.suggest.showUnits
Desc: When enabled IntelliSense shows `unit`-suggestions.

Name: editor.suggest.showUsers
Desc: When enabled IntelliSense shows `user`-suggestions.

Name: editor.suggest.showValues
Desc: When enabled IntelliSense shows `value`-suggestions.

Name: editor.suggest.showVariables
Desc: When enabled IntelliSense shows `variable`-suggestions.

Name: editor.suggest.showWords
Desc: When enabled IntelliSense shows `text`-suggestions.

Name: editor.suggest.snippetsPreventQuickSuggestions
Desc: Controls whether an active snippet prevents quick suggestions.

Name: editor.suggestFontSize
Desc: Font size for the suggest widget. When set to `0`, the value of `editor.fontSize` is used.

Name: editor.suggestLineHeight
Desc: Line height for the suggest widget. When set to `0`, the value of `editor.lineHeight` is used. The minimum value is 8.

Name: editor.suggestOnTriggerCharacters
Desc: Controls whether suggestions should automatically show up when typing trigger characters.

Name: editor.suggestSelection
Desc: Controls how suggestions are pre-selected when showing the suggest list. - first: Always select the first suggestion. - recentlyUsed: Select recent suggestions unless further typing selects one, e.g. `console.| -> console.log` because `log` has been completed recently. - recentlyUsedByPrefix: Select suggestions based on previous prefixes that have completed those suggestions, e.g. `co -> console` and `con -> const`.

Name: editor.tabCompletion
Desc: Enables tab completions. - on: Tab complete will insert the best matching suggestion when pressing tab. - off: Disable tab completions. - onlySnippets: Tab complete snippets when their prefix match. Works best when 'quickSuggestions' aren't enabled.

Name: editor.tabFocusMode
Desc: Controls whether the editor receives tabs or defers them to the workbench for navigation.

Name: editor.tabSize
Desc: The number of spaces a tab is equal to. This setting is overridden based on the file contents when `editor.detectIndentation` is on.

Name: editor.trimAutoWhitespace
Desc: Remove trailing auto inserted whitespace.

Name: editor.trimWhitespaceOnDelete
Desc: Controls whether the editor will also delete the next line's indentation whitespace when deleting a newline.

Name: editor.unfoldOnClickAfterEndOfLine
Desc: Controls whether clicking on the empty content after a folded line will unfold the line.

Name: editor.unicodeHighlight.allowedCharacters
Desc: Defines allowed characters that are not being highlighted.

Name: editor.unicodeHighlight.allowedLocales
Desc: Unicode characters that are common in allowed locales are not being highlighted.

Name: editor.unicodeHighlight.ambiguousCharacters
Desc: Controls whether characters are highlighted that can be confused with basic ASCII characters, except those that are common in the current user locale.

Name: editor.unicodeHighlight.includeComments
Desc: Controls whether characters in comments should also be subject to Unicode highlighting.

Name: editor.unicodeHighlight.includeStrings
Desc: Controls whether characters in strings should also be subject to Unicode highlighting.

Name: editor.unicodeHighlight.invisibleCharacters
Desc: Controls whether characters that just reserve space or have no width at all are highlighted.

Name: editor.unicodeHighlight.nonBasicASCII
Desc: Controls whether all non-basic ASCII characters are highlighted. Only characters between U+0020 and U+007E, tab, line-feed and carriage-return are considered basic ASCII.

Name: editor.unusualLineTerminators
Desc: Remove unusual line terminators that might cause problems. - auto: Unusual line terminators are automatically removed. - off: Unusual line terminators are ignored. - prompt: Unusual line terminators prompt to be removed.

Name: editor.useTabStops
Desc: Spaces and tabs are inserted and deleted in alignment with tab stops.

Name: editor.wordBasedSuggestions
Desc: Controls whether completions should be computed based on words in the document and from which documents they are computed. - off: Turn off Word Based Suggestions. - offWithInlineSuggestions: Turn off Word Based Suggestions when Inline Suggestions are present. - currentDocument: Only suggest words from the active document. - matchingDocuments: Suggest words from all open documents of the same language. - allDocuments: Suggest words from all open documents.

Name: editor.wordBreak
Desc: Controls the word break rules used for Chinese/Japanese/Korean (CJK) text. - normal: Use the default line break rule. - keepAll: Word breaks should not be used for Chinese/Japanese/Korean (CJK) text. Non-CJK text behavior is the same as for normal.

Name: editor.wordSegmenterLocales
Desc: Locales to be used for word segmentation when doing word related navigations or operations. Specify the BCP 47 language tag of the word you wish to recognize (e.g., ja, zh-CN, zh-Hant-TW, etc.).

Name: editor.wordSeparators
Desc: Characters that will be used as word separators when doing word related navigations or operations.

Name: editor.wordWrap
Desc: Controls how lines should wrap. - off: Lines will never wrap. - on: Lines will wrap at the viewport width. - wordWrapColumn: Lines will wrap at `editor.wordWrapColumn`. - bounded: Lines will wrap at the minimum of viewport and `editor.wordWrapColumn`.

Name: editor.wordWrapColumn
Desc: Controls the wrapping column of the editor when `editor.wordWrap` is `wordWrapColumn` or `bounded`.

Name: editor.wrapOnEscapedLineFeeds
Desc: Controls whether literal `\n` shall trigger a wordWrap when `editor.wordWrap` is enabled.

Name: editor.wrappingIndent
Desc: Controls the indentation of wrapped lines. - none: No indentation. Wrapped lines begin at column 1. - same: Wrapped lines get the same indentation as the parent. - indent: Wrapped lines get +1 indentation toward the parent. - deepIndent: Wrapped lines get +2 indentation toward the parent.

Name: editor.wrappingStrategy
Desc: Controls the algorithm that computes wrapping points. Note that when in accessibility mode, advanced will be used for the best experience. - simple: Assumes that all characters are of the same width. This is a fast algorithm that works correctly for monospace fonts and certain scripts (like Latin characters) where glyphs are of equal width. - advanced: Delegates wrapping points computation to the browser. This is a slow algorithm, that might cause freezes for large files, but it works correctly in all cases.

Name: editor.aiStats.enabled
Desc: Controls whether to enable AI statistics in the editor. The gauge shows the average AI rate across 5-minute sessions, where each session's rate is calculated as AI-inserted characters divided by total inserted characters.

Name: editor.rename.enablePreview
Desc: Enable/disable the ability to preview changes before renaming

Name: editor.semanticTokenColorCustomizations
Desc: Overrides editor semantic token color and styles from the currently selected color theme.

Name: editor.tokenColorCustomizations
Desc: Overrides editor syntax colors and font style from the currently selected color theme.

Name: emmet.excludeLanguages
Desc: An array of languages where Emmet abbreviations should not be expanded.

Name: emmet.extensionsPath
Desc: An array of paths, where each path can contain Emmet syntaxProfiles and/or snippet files. In case of conflicts, the profiles/snippets of later paths will override those of earlier paths. See https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/editor/emmet for more information and an example snippet file.

Name: emmet.includeLanguages
Desc: Enable Emmet abbreviations in languages that are not supported by default. Add a mapping here between the language and Emmet supported language. For example: `{"vue-html": "html", "javascript": "javascriptreact"}`

Name: emmet.optimizeStylesheetParsing
Desc: When set to `false`, the whole file is parsed to determine if current position is valid for expanding Emmet abbreviations. When set to `true`, only the content around the current position in CSS/SCSS/Less files is parsed.

Name: emmet.preferences
Desc: Preferences used to modify behavior of some actions and resolvers of Emmet.

Name: emmet.showAbbreviationSuggestions
Desc: Shows possible Emmet abbreviations as suggestions. Not applicable in stylesheets or when emmet.showExpandedAbbreviation is set to `"never"`.

Name: emmet.showExpandedAbbreviation
Desc: Shows expanded Emmet abbreviations as suggestions. The option `"inMarkupAndStylesheetFilesOnly"` applies to html, haml, jade, slim, xml, xsl, css, scss, sass, less and stylus. The option `"always"` applies to all parts of the file regardless of markup/css.

Name: emmet.showSuggestionsAsSnippets
Desc: If `true`, then Emmet suggestions will show up as snippets allowing you to order them as per `editor.snippetSuggestions` setting.

Name: emmet.syntaxProfiles
Desc: Define profile for specified syntax or use your own profile with specific rules.

Name: emmet.triggerExpansionOnTab
Desc: When enabled, Emmet abbreviations are expanded when pressing TAB, even when completions do not show up. When disabled, completions that show up can still be accepted by pressing TAB.

Name: emmet.useInlineCompletions
Desc: If `true`, Emmet will use inline completions to suggest expansions. To prevent the non-inline completion item provider from showing up as often while this setting is `true`, turn `editor.quickSuggestions` to `inline` or `off` for the `other` item.

Name: emmet.variables
Desc: Variables to be used in Emmet snippets.

Name: explorer.autoOpenDroppedFile
Desc: Controls whether the Explorer should automatically open a file when it is dropped into the explorer

Name: explorer.autoReveal
Desc: Controls whether the Explorer should automatically reveal and select files when opening them. - true: Files will be revealed and selected. - false: Files will not be revealed and selected. - focusNoScroll: Files will not be scrolled into view, but will still be focused.

Name: explorer.autoRevealExclude
Desc: Configure paths or [glob patterns](https://aka.ms/vscode-glob-patterns) for excluding files and folders from being revealed and selected in the Explorer when they are opened. Glob patterns are always evaluated relative to the path of the workspace folder unless they are absolute paths.

Name: explorer.compactFolders
Desc: Controls whether the Explorer should render folders in a compact form. In such a form, single child folders will be compressed in a combined tree element. Useful for Java package structures, for example.

Name: explorer.confirmDelete
Desc: Controls whether the Explorer should ask for confirmation when deleting files and folders.

Name: explorer.confirmDragAndDrop
Desc: Controls whether the Explorer should ask for confirmation to move files and folders via drag and drop.

Name: explorer.confirmPasteNative
Desc: Controls whether the Explorer should ask for confirmation when pasting native files and folders.

Name: explorer.confirmUndo
Desc: Controls whether the Explorer should ask for confirmation when undoing. - verbose: Explorer will prompt before all undo operations. - default: Explorer will prompt before destructive undo operations. - light: Explorer will not prompt before undo operations when focused.

Name: explorer.copyPathSeparator
Desc: The path separation character used when copying file paths. - /: Use slash as path separation character. - \: Use backslash as path separation character. - auto: Uses operating system specific path separation character.

Name: explorer.copyRelativePathSeparator
Desc: The path separation character used when copying relative file paths. - /: Use slash as path separation character. - \: Use backslash as path separation character. - auto: Uses operating system specific path separation character.

Name: explorer.decorations.badges
Desc: Controls whether file decorations should use badges.

Name: explorer.decorations.colors
Desc: Controls whether file decorations should use colors.

Name: explorer.enableDragAndDrop
Desc: Controls whether the Explorer should allow to move files and folders via drag and drop. This setting only effects drag and drop from inside the Explorer.

Name: explorer.enableUndo
Desc: Controls whether the Explorer should support undoing file and folder operations.

Name: explorer.excludeGitIgnore
Desc: Controls whether entries in .gitignore should be parsed and excluded from the Explorer. Similar to `files.exclude`.

Name: explorer.expandSingleFolderWorkspaces
Desc: Controls whether the Explorer should expand multi-root workspaces containing only one folder during initialization

Name: explorer.fileNesting.enabled
Desc: Controls whether file nesting is enabled in the Explorer. File nesting allows for related files in a directory to be visually grouped together under a single parent file.

Name: explorer.fileNesting.expand
Desc: Controls whether file nests are automatically expanded. `explorer.fileNesting.enabled` must be set for this to take effect.

Name: explorer.fileNesting.patterns
Desc: Controls nesting of files in the Explorer. `explorer.fileNesting.enabled` must be set for this to take effect. Each __Item__ represents a parent pattern and may contain a single `*` character that matches any string. Each __Value__ represents a comma separated list of the child patterns that should be shown nested under a given parent. Child patterns may contain several special tokens: - `${capture}`: Matches the resolved value of the `*` from the parent pattern - `${basename}`: Matches the parent file's basename, the `file` in `file.ts` - `${extname}`: Matches the parent file's extension, the `ts` in `file.ts` - `${dirname}`: Matches the parent file's directory name, the `src` in `src/file.ts` - `*`:  Matches any string, may only be used once per child pattern

Name: explorer.incrementalNaming
Desc: Controls which naming strategy to use when giving a new name to a duplicated Explorer item on paste. - simple: Appends the word "copy" at the end of the duplicated name potentially followed by a number. - smart: Adds a number at the end of the duplicated name. If some number is already part of the name, tries to increase that number. - disabled: Disables incremental naming. If two files with the same name exist you will be prompted to overwrite the existing file.

Name: explorer.openEditors.minVisible
Desc: The minimum number of editor slots pre-allocated in the Open Editors pane. If set to 0 the Open Editors pane will dynamically resize based on the number of editors.

Name: explorer.openEditors.sortOrder
Desc: Controls the sorting order of editors in the Open Editors pane. - editorOrder: Editors are ordered in the same order editor tabs are shown. - alphabetical: Editors are ordered alphabetically by tab name inside each editor group. - fullPath: Editors are ordered alphabetically by full path inside each editor group.

Name: explorer.openEditors.visible
Desc: The initial maximum number of editors shown in the Open Editors pane. Exceeding this limit will show a scroll bar and allow resizing the pane to display more items.

Name: explorer.sortOrder
Desc: Controls the property-based sorting of files and folders in the Explorer. When `explorer.fileNesting.enabled` is enabled, also controls sorting of nested files. - default: Files and folders are sorted by their names. Folders are displayed before files. - mixed: Files and folders are sorted by their names. Files are interwoven with folders. - filesFirst: Files and folders are sorted by their names. Files are displayed before folders. - type: Files and folders are grouped by extension type then sorted by their names. Folders are displayed before files. - modified: Files and folders are sorted by last modified date in descending order. Folders are displayed before files. - foldersNestsFiles: Files and folders are sorted by their names. Folders are displayed before files. Files with nested children are displayed before other files.

Name: explorer.sortOrderLexicographicOptions
Desc: Controls the lexicographic sorting of file and folder names in the Explorer. - default: Uppercase and lowercase names are mixed together. - upper: Uppercase names are grouped together before lowercase names. - lower: Lowercase names are grouped together before uppercase names. - unicode: Names are sorted in Unicode order.

Name: explorer.sortOrderReverse
Desc: Controls whether the file and folder sort order, should be reversed.

Name: extensions.allowed
Desc: Specify a list of extensions that are allowed to use. This helps maintain a secure and consistent development environment by restricting the use of unauthorized extensions. For more information on how to configure this setting, please visit the [Configure Allowed Extensions](https://aka.ms/vscode/enterprise/extensions/allowed) section.

Name: extensions.allowOpenInModalEditor
Desc: Controls whether extensions and MCP servers open in a modal editor overlay.

Name: extensions.autoCheckUpdates
Desc: When enabled, automatically checks extensions for updates. If an extension has an update, it is marked as outdated in the Extensions view. The updates are fetched from a Microsoft online service.

Name: extensions.autoUpdate
Desc: Controls the automatic update behavior of extensions. The updates are fetched from a Microsoft online service. - on: Download and install updates automatically only for enabled extensions. - off: Extensions are not automatically updated.

Name: extensions.autoUpdateDelay
Desc: Controls the delay in hours after an extension update is published before it is automatically installed. Only applies when `extensions.autoUpdate` is set to `on`. This delay helps avoid installing potentially problematic updates immediately after release.

Name: extensions.closeExtensionDetailsOnViewChange
Desc: When enabled, editors with extension details will be automatically closed upon navigating away from the Extensions View.

Name: extensions.confirmedUriHandlerExtensionIds
Desc: When an extension is listed here, a confirmation prompt will not be shown when that extension handles a URI.

Name: extensions.experimental.affinity
Desc: Configure an extension to execute in a different extension host process.

Name: extensions.experimental.deferredStartupFinishedActivation
Desc: When enabled, extensions which declare the `onStartupFinished` activation event will be activated after a timeout.

Name: extensions.experimental.issueQuickAccess
Desc: When enabled, extensions can be searched for via Quick Access and report issues from there.

Name: extensions.ignoreRecommendations
Desc: When enabled, the notifications for extension recommendations will not be shown.

Name: extensions.requestTimeout
Desc: Controls the timeout in milliseconds for HTTP requests made when fetching extensions from the Marketplace

Name: extensions.showRecommendationsOnlyOnDemand
Desc: This setting is deprecated. Use extensions.ignoreRecommendations setting to control recommendation notifications. Use Extensions view's visibility actions to hide Recommended view by default.

Name: extensions.supportAgentsWindow
Desc: Override the Agents window support of an extension. Extensions using `true` will be enabled in the Agents window even when they would otherwise be disabled.

Name: extensions.supportNodeGlobalNavigator
Desc: When enabled, Node.js navigator object is exposed on the global scope.

Name: extensions.supportUntrustedWorkspaces
Desc: Override the untrusted workspace support of an extension. Extensions using `true` will always be enabled. Extensions using `limited` will always be enabled, and the extension will hide functionality that requires trust. Extensions using `false` will only be enabled only when the workspace is trusted.

Name: extensions.supportVirtualWorkspaces
Desc: Override the virtual workspaces support of an extension.

Name: extensions.verifySignature
Desc: When enabled, extensions are verified to be signed before getting installed.

Name: extensions.webWorker
Desc: Enable web worker extension host. - true: The Web Worker Extension Host will always be launched. - false: The Web Worker Extension Host will never be launched. - auto: The Web Worker Extension Host will be launched when a web extension needs it.

Name: files.associations
Desc: Configure [glob patterns](https://aka.ms/vscode-glob-patterns) of file associations to languages (for example `"*.extension": "html"`). Patterns will match on the absolute path of a file if they contain a path separator and will match on the name of the file otherwise. These have precedence over the default associations of the languages installed.

Name: files.autoGuessEncoding
Desc: When enabled, the editor will attempt to guess the character set encoding when opening files. This setting can also be configured per language. Note, this setting is not respected by text search. Only `files.encoding` is respected.

Name: files.autoSave
Desc: Controls [auto save](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/editor/codebasics#_save-auto-save) of editors that have unsaved changes. - off: An editor with changes is never automatically saved. - afterDelay: An editor with changes is automatically saved after the configured `files.autoSaveDelay`. - onFocusChange: An editor with changes is automatically saved when the editor loses focus. - onWindowChange: An editor with changes is automatically saved when the window loses focus.

Name: files.autoSaveDelay
Desc: Controls the delay in milliseconds after which an editor with unsaved changes is saved automatically. Only applies when `files.autoSave` is set to `afterDelay`.

Name: files.autoSaveWhenNoErrors
Desc: When enabled, will limit [auto save](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/editor/codebasics#_save-auto-save) of editors to files that have no errors reported in them at the time the auto save is triggered. Only applies when `files.autoSave` is enabled.

Name: files.autoSaveWorkspaceFilesOnly
Desc: When enabled, will limit [auto save](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/editor/codebasics#_save-auto-save) of editors to files that are inside the opened workspace. Only applies when `files.autoSave` is enabled.

Name: files.candidateGuessEncodings
Desc: List of character set encodings that the editor should attempt to guess in the order they are listed. In case it cannot be determined, `files.encoding` is respected - utf8: UTF-8 - utf16le: UTF-16 LE - utf16be: UTF-16 BE - windows1252: Western (Windows 1252) - windows1250: Central European (Windows 1250) - iso88592: Central European (ISO 8859-2) - windows1251: Cyrillic (Windows 1251) - cp866: Cyrillic (CP 866) - cp1125: Cyrillic (CP 1125) - iso88595: Cyrillic (ISO 8859-5) - koi8r: Cyrillic (KOI8-R) - windows1253: Greek (Windows 1253) - iso88597: Greek (ISO 8859-7) - windows1255: Hebrew (Windows 1255) - iso88598: Hebrew (ISO 8859-8) - cp950: Traditional Chinese (Big5) - shiftjis: Japanese (Shift JIS) - eucjp: Japanese (EUC-JP) - euckr: Korean (EUC-KR) - gb2312: Simplified Chinese (GB 2312)

Name: files.defaultLanguage
Desc: The default language identifier that is assigned to new files. If configured to `${activeEditorLanguage}`, will use the language identifier of the currently active text editor if any.

Name: files.dialog.defaultPath
Desc: Default path for file dialogs, overriding user's home path. Only used in the absence of a context-specific path, such as most recently opened file or folder.

Name: files.enableTrash
Desc: Moves files/folders to the OS trash (recycle bin on Windows) when deleting. Disabling this will delete files/folders permanently.

Name: files.encoding
Desc: The default character set encoding to use when reading and writing files. This setting can also be configured per language. - utf8: UTF-8 - utf8bom: UTF-8 with BOM - utf16le: UTF-16 LE - utf16be: UTF-16 BE - windows1252: Western (Windows 1252) - iso88591: Western (ISO 8859-1) - iso88593: Western (ISO 8859-3) - iso885915: Western (ISO 8859-15) - macroman: Western (Mac Roman) - cp437: DOS (CP 437) - windows1256: Arabic (Windows 1256) - iso88596: Arabic (ISO 8859-6) - windows1257: Baltic (Windows 1257) - iso88594: Baltic (ISO 8859-4) - iso885914: Celtic (ISO 8859-14) - windows1250: Central European (Windows 1250) - iso88592: Central European (ISO 8859-2) - cp852: Central European (CP 852) - windows1251: Cyrillic (Windows 1251) - cp866: Cyrillic (CP 866) - cp1125: Cyrillic (CP 1125) - iso88595: Cyrillic (ISO 8859-5) - koi8r: Cyrillic (KOI8-R) - koi8u: Cyrillic (KOI8-U) - iso885913: Estonian (ISO 8859-13) - windows1253: Greek (Windows 1253) - iso88597: Greek (ISO 8859-7) - windows1255: Hebrew (Windows 1255) - iso88598: Hebrew (ISO 8859-8) - iso885910: Nordic (ISO 8859-10) - iso885916: Romanian (ISO 8859-16) - windows1254: Turkish (Windows 1254) - iso88599: Turkish (ISO 8859-9) - cp857: Turkish (CP 857) - windows1258: Vietnamese (Windows 1258) - gbk: Simplified Chinese (GBK) - gb18030: Simplified Chinese (GB18030) - cp950: Traditional Chinese (Big5) - big5hkscs: Traditional Chinese (Big5-HKSCS) - shiftjis: Japanese (Shift JIS) - eucjp: Japanese (EUC-JP) - euckr: Korean (EUC-KR) - windows874: Thai (Windows 874) - iso885911: Latin/Thai (ISO 8859-11) - koi8ru: Cyrillic (KOI8-RU) - koi8t: Tajik (KOI8-T) - gb2312: Simplified Chinese (GB 2312) - cp865: Nordic DOS (CP 865) - cp850: Western European DOS (CP 850)

Name: files.eol
Desc: The default end of line character. - \n: LF - \r\n: CRLF - auto: Uses operating system specific end of line character.

Name: files.exclude
Desc: Configure [glob patterns](https://aka.ms/vscode-glob-patterns) for excluding files and folders. For example, the File Explorer decides which files and folders to show or hide based on this setting. Refer to the `search.exclude` setting to define search-specific excludes. Refer to the `explorer.excludeGitIgnore` setting for ignoring files based on your `.gitignore`.

Name: files.hotExit
Desc: [Hot Exit](https://aka.ms/vscode-hot-exit) controls whether unsaved files are remembered between sessions, allowing the save prompt when exiting the editor to be skipped. - off: Disable hot exit. A prompt will show when attempting to close a window with editors that have unsaved changes. - onExit: Hot exit will be triggered when the last window is closed on Windows/Linux or when the `workbench.action.quit` command is triggered (command palette, keybinding, menu). All windows without folders opened will be restored upon next launch. A list of previously opened windows with unsaved files can be accessed via `File > Open Recent > More...` - onExitAndWindowClose: Hot exit will be triggered when the last window is closed on Windows/Linux or when the `workbench.action.quit` command is triggered (command palette, keybinding, menu), and also for any window with a folder opened regardless of whether it's the last window. All windows without folders opened will be restored upon next launch. A list of previously opened windows with unsaved files can be accessed via `File > Open Recent > More...`

Name: files.insertFinalNewline
Desc: When enabled, insert a final new line at the end of the file when saving it.

Name: files.participants.timeout
Desc: Timeout in milliseconds after which file participants for create, rename, and delete are cancelled. Use `0` to disable participants.

Name: files.readonlyExclude
Desc: Configure paths or [glob patterns](https://aka.ms/vscode-glob-patterns) to exclude from being marked as read-only if they match as a result of the `files.readonlyInclude` setting. Glob patterns are always evaluated relative to the path of the workspace folder unless they are absolute paths. Files from readonly file system providers will always be read-only independent of this setting.

Name: files.readonlyFromPermissions
Desc: Marks files as read-only when their file permissions indicate as such. This can be overridden via `files.readonlyInclude` and `files.readonlyExclude` settings.

Name: files.readonlyInclude
Desc: Configure paths or [glob patterns](https://aka.ms/vscode-glob-patterns) to mark as read-only. Glob patterns are always evaluated relative to the path of the workspace folder unless they are absolute paths. You can exclude matching paths via the `files.readonlyExclude` setting. Files from readonly file system providers will always be read-only independent of this setting.

Name: files.restoreUndoStack
Desc: Restore the undo stack when a file is reopened.

Name: files.saveConflictResolution
Desc: A save conflict can occur when a file is saved to disk that was changed by another program in the meantime. To prevent data loss, the user is asked to compare the changes in the editor with the version on disk. This setting should only be changed if you frequently encounter save conflict errors and may result in data loss if used without caution. - askUser: Will refuse to save and ask for resolving the save conflict manually. - overwriteFileOnDisk: Will resolve the save conflict by overwriting the file on disk with the changes in the editor.

Name: files.simpleDialog.enable
Desc: Enables the simple file dialog for opening and saving files and folders. The simple file dialog replaces the system file dialog when enabled.

Name: files.trimFinalNewlines
Desc: When enabled, will trim all new lines after the final new line at the end of the file when saving it.

Name: files.trimTrailingWhitespace
Desc: When enabled, will trim trailing whitespace when saving a file.

Name: files.trimTrailingWhitespaceInRegexAndStrings
Desc: When enabled, trailing whitespace will be removed from multiline strings and regexes on save or when executing 'editor.action.trimTrailingWhitespace'. This can cause whitespace to not be trimmed from lines when there isn't up-to-date token information.

Name: files.watcherExclude
Desc: Configure paths or [glob patterns](https://aka.ms/vscode-glob-patterns) to exclude from file watching. Paths can either be relative to the watched folder or absolute. Glob patterns are matched relative from the watched folder. When you experience the file watcher process consuming a lot of CPU, make sure to exclude large folders that are of less interest (such as build output folders).

Name: files.watcherInclude
Desc: Configure extra paths to watch for changes inside the workspace. By default, all workspace folders will be watched recursively, except for folders that are symbolic links. You can explicitly add absolute or relative paths to support watching folders that are symbolic links. Relative paths will be resolved to an absolute path using the currently opened workspace.

Name: files.refactoring.autoSave
Desc: Controls if files that were part of a refactoring are saved automatically

Name: git.addAICoAuthor
Desc: Controls whether a 'Co-authored-by' trailer is automatically added to the commit message when AI-generated code is included in the commit. - off: Never add the AI co-author trailer. - chatAndAgent: Add the AI co-author trailer when code from chat or agent edits is included. - all: Add the AI co-author trailer when any AI-generated code is included, such as inline completions, chat, or agent edits.

Name: git.allowForcePush
Desc: Controls whether force push (with or without lease) is enabled.

Name: git.allowNoVerifyCommit
Desc: Controls whether commits without running pre-commit and commit-msg hooks are allowed.

Name: git.alwaysShowStagedChangesResourceGroup
Desc: Always show the Staged Changes resource group.

Name: git.alwaysSignOff
Desc: Controls the signoff flag for all commits.

Name: git.autofetch
Desc: When set to true, commits will automatically be fetched from the default remote of the current Git repository. Setting to `all` will fetch from all remotes.

Name: git.autofetchPeriod
Desc: Duration in seconds between each automatic git fetch, when `git.autofetch` is enabled.

Name: git.autorefresh
Desc: Whether auto refreshing is enabled.

Name: git.autoRepositoryDetection
Desc: Configures when repositories should be automatically detected. - true: Scan for both subfolders of the current opened folder and parent folders of open files. - false: Disable automatic repository scanning. - subFolders: Scan for subfolders of the currently opened folder. - openEditors: Scan for parent folders of open files.

Name: git.autoStash
Desc: Stash any changes before pulling and restore them after successful pull.

Name: git.blame.editorDecoration.disableHover
Desc: Controls whether to disable the blame information editor decoration hover.

Name: git.blame.editorDecoration.enabled
Desc: Controls whether to show blame information in the editor using editor decorations.

Name: git.blame.editorDecoration.template
Desc: Template for the blame information editor decoration. Supported variables: * `hashShort`: First N characters of the commit hash according to `git.commitShortHashLength` * `subject`: First line of the commit message * `authorName`: Author name * `authorEmail`: Author email * `authorDate`: Author date * `authorDateAgo`: Time difference between now and the author date

Name: git.blame.ignoreWhitespace
Desc: Controls whether to ignore whitespace changes when computing blame information.

Name: git.blame.statusBarItem.enabled
Desc: Controls whether to show blame information in the status bar.

Name: git.blame.statusBarItem.template
Desc: Template for the blame information status bar item. Supported variables: * `hashShort`: First N characters of the commit hash according to `git.commitShortHashLength` * `subject`: First line of the commit message * `authorName`: Author name * `authorEmail`: Author email * `authorDate`: Author date * `authorDateAgo`: Time difference between now and the author date

Name: git.branchPrefix
Desc: Prefix used when creating a new branch.

Name: git.branchProtection
Desc: List of protected branches. By default, a prompt is shown before changes are committed to a protected branch. The prompt can be controlled using the `git.branchProtectionPrompt`  setting.

Name: git.branchProtectionPrompt
Desc: Controls whether a prompt is being shown before changes are committed to a protected branch. - alwaysCommit: Always commit changes to the protected branch. - alwaysCommitToNewBranch: Always commit changes to a new branch. - alwaysPrompt: Always prompt before changes are committed to a protected branch.

Name: git.branchRandomName.dictionary
Desc: List of dictionaries used for the randomly generated branch name. Each value represents the dictionary used to generate the segment of the branch name. Supported dictionaries: `adjectives`, `animals`, `colors` and `numbers`. - adjectives: A random adjective - animals: A random animal name - colors: A random color name - numbers: A random number between 100 and 999

Name: git.branchRandomName.enable
