Desc: Controls whether a random name is generated when creating a new branch.

Name: git.branchSortOrder
Desc: Controls the sort order for branches.

Name: git.branchValidationRegex
Desc: A regular expression to validate new branch names.

Name: git.branchWhitespaceChar
Desc: The character to replace whitespace in new branch names, and to separate segments of a randomly generated branch name.

Name: git.checkoutType
Desc: Controls what type of Git refs are listed when running `Checkout to...`. - local: Local branches - tags: Tags - remote: Remote branches

Name: git.closeDiffOnOperation
Desc: Controls whether the diff editor should be automatically closed when changes are stashed, committed, discarded, staged, or unstaged.

Name: git.commandsToLog
Desc: List of git commands (ex: commit, push) that would have their `stdout` logged to the [git output](command:git.showOutput). If the git command has a client-side hook configured, the client-side hook's `stdout` will also be logged to the [git output](command:git.showOutput).

Name: git.commitShortHashLength
Desc: Controls the length of the commit short hash.

Name: git.confirmCommittedDelete
Desc: Confirm before deleting committed files with Git.

Name: git.confirmEmptyCommits
Desc: Always confirm the creation of empty commits for the 'Git: Commit Empty' command.

Name: git.confirmForcePush
Desc: Controls whether to ask for confirmation before force-pushing.

Name: git.confirmNoVerifyCommit
Desc: Controls whether to ask for confirmation before committing without verification.

Name: git.confirmSync
Desc: Confirm before synchronizing Git repositories.

Name: git.countBadge
Desc: Controls the Git count badge. - all: Count all changes. - tracked: Count only tracked changes. - off: Turn off counter.

Name: git.decorations.enabled
Desc: Controls whether Git contributes colors and badges to the Explorer and the Open Editors view.

Name: git.defaultBranchName
Desc: The name of the default branch (example: main, trunk, development) when initializing a new Git repository. When set to empty, the default branch name configured in Git will be used. **Note:** Requires Git version `2.28.0` or later.

Name: git.defaultCloneDirectory
Desc: The default location to clone a Git repository.

Name: git.detectSubmodules
Desc: Controls whether to automatically detect Git submodules.

Name: git.detectSubmodulesLimit
Desc: Controls the limit of Git submodules detected.

Name: git.detectWorktrees
Desc: Controls whether to automatically detect Git worktrees.

Name: git.detectWorktreesLimit
Desc: Controls the limit of Git worktrees detected.

Name: git.diagnosticsCommitHook.enabled
Desc: Controls whether to check for unresolved diagnostics before committing.

Name: git.diagnosticsCommitHook.sources
Desc: Controls the list of sources (**Item**) and the minimum severity (**Value**) to be considered before committing. **Note:** To ignore diagnostics from a particular source, add the source to the list and set the minimum severity to `none`.

Name: git.discardUntrackedChangesToTrash
Desc: Controls whether discarding untracked changes moves the file(s) to the Recycle Bin (Windows), Trash (macOS, Linux) instead of deleting them permanently. **Note:** This setting has no effect when connected to a remote or when running in Linux as a snap package.

Name: git.enableCommitSigning
Desc: Enables commit signing with GPG, X.509, or SSH.

Name: git.enabled
Desc: Whether Git is enabled.

Name: git.enableSmartCommit
Desc: Commit all changes when there are no staged changes.

Name: git.enableStatusBarSync
Desc: Controls whether the Git Sync command appears in the status bar.

Name: git.fetchOnPull
Desc: When enabled, fetch all branches when pulling. Otherwise, fetch just the current one.

Name: git.followTagsWhenSync
Desc: Push all annotated tags when running the sync command.

Name: git.githubAuthentication
Desc: This setting is now deprecated, please use `github.gitAuthentication` instead.

Name: git.ignoredRepositories
Desc: List of Git repositories to ignore.

Name: git.ignoreLegacyWarning
Desc: Ignores the legacy Git warning.

Name: git.ignoreLimitWarning
Desc: Ignores the warning when there are too many changes in a repository.

Name: git.ignoreMissingGitWarning
Desc: Ignores the warning when Git is missing.

Name: git.ignoreRebaseWarning
Desc: Ignores the warning when it looks like the branch might have been rebased when pulling.

Name: git.ignoreSubmodules
Desc: Ignore modifications to submodules in the file tree.

Name: git.ignoreWindowsGit27Warning
Desc: Ignores the warning when Git 2.25 - 2.26 is installed on Windows.

Name: git.inputValidation
Desc: Controls whether to show commit message input validation diagnostics.

Name: git.inputValidationLength
Desc: Controls the commit message length threshold for showing a warning.

Name: git.inputValidationSubjectLength
Desc: Controls the commit message subject length threshold for showing a warning. Unset it to inherit the value of `git.inputValidationLength`.

Name: git.mergeEditor
Desc: Open the merge editor for files that are currently under conflict.

Name: git.openAfterClone
Desc: Controls whether to open a repository automatically after cloning. - always: Always open in current window. - alwaysNewWindow: Always open in a new window. - whenNoFolderOpen: Only open in current window when no folder is opened. - prompt: Always prompt for action.

Name: git.openDiffOnClick
Desc: Controls whether the diff editor should be opened when clicking a change. Otherwise the regular editor will be opened.

Name: git.openRepositoryInParentFolders
Desc: Control whether a repository in parent folders of workspaces or open files should be opened. - always: Always open a repository in parent folders of workspaces or open files. - never: Never open a repository in parent folders of workspaces or open files. - prompt: Prompt before opening a repository the parent folders of workspaces or open files.

Name: git.optimisticUpdate
Desc: Controls whether to optimistically update the state of the Source Control view after running git commands.

Name: git.path
Desc: Path and filename of the git executable, e.g. `C:\Program Files\Git\bin\git.exe` (Windows). This can also be an array of string values containing multiple paths to look up.

Name: git.postCommitCommand
Desc: Run a git command after a successful commit. - none: Don't run any command after a commit. - push: Run 'git push' after a successful commit. - sync: Run 'git pull' and 'git push' after a successful commit.

Name: git.promptToSaveFilesBeforeCommit
Desc: Controls whether Git should check for unsaved files before committing. - always: Check for any unsaved files. - staged: Check only for unsaved staged files. - never: Disable this check.

Name: git.promptToSaveFilesBeforeStash
Desc: Controls whether Git should check for unsaved files before stashing changes. - always: Check for any unsaved files. - staged: Check only for unsaved staged files. - never: Disable this check.

Name: git.pruneOnFetch
Desc: Prune when fetching.

Name: git.pullBeforeCheckout
Desc: Controls whether a branch that does not have outgoing commits is fast-forwarded before it is checked out.

Name: git.pullTags
Desc: Fetch all tags when pulling.

Name: git.rebaseWhenSync
Desc: Force Git to use rebase when running the sync command.

Name: git.rememberPostCommitCommand
Desc: Remember the last git command that ran after a commit.

Name: git.replaceTagsWhenPull
Desc: Automatically replace the local tags with the remote tags in case of a conflict when running the pull command.

Name: git.repositoryScanIgnoredFolders
Desc: List of folders that are ignored while scanning for Git repositories when `git.autoRepositoryDetection` is set to `true` or `subFolders`.

Name: git.repositoryScanMaxDepth
Desc: Controls the depth used when scanning workspace folders for Git repositories when `git.autoRepositoryDetection` is set to `true` or `subFolders`. Can be set to `-1` for no limit.

Name: git.requireGitUserConfig
Desc: Controls whether to require explicit Git user configuration or allow Git to guess if missing.

Name: git.scanRepositories
Desc: List of paths to search for Git repositories in.

Name: git.showActionButton
Desc: Controls whether an action button is shown in the Source Control view.

Name: git.showCommitInput
Desc: Controls whether to show the commit input in the Git source control panel.

Name: git.showInlineOpenFileAction
Desc: Controls whether to show an inline Open File action in the Git changes view.

Name: git.showProgress
Desc: Controls whether Git actions should show progress.

Name: git.showPushSuccessNotification
Desc: Controls whether to show a notification when a push is successful.

Name: git.showReferenceDetails
Desc: Controls whether to show the details of the last commit for Git refs in the checkout, branch, and tag pickers.

Name: git.similarityThreshold
Desc: Controls the threshold of the similarity index (the amount of additions/deletions compared to the file's size) for changes in a pair of added/deleted files to be considered a rename. **Note:** Requires Git version `2.18.0` or later.

Name: git.smartCommitChanges
Desc: Control which changes are automatically staged by Smart Commit. - all: Automatically stage all changes. - tracked: Automatically stage tracked changes only.

Name: git.statusLimit
Desc: Controls how to limit the number of changes that can be parsed from Git status command. Can be set to 0 for no limit.

Name: git.suggestSmartCommit
Desc: Suggests to enable smart commit (commit all changes when there are no staged changes).

Name: git.supportCancellation
Desc: Controls whether a notification comes up when running the Sync action, which allows the user to cancel the operation.

Name: git.terminalAuthentication
Desc: Controls whether to enable VS Code to be the authentication handler for Git processes spawned in the Integrated Terminal. Note: Terminals need to be restarted to pick up a change in this setting.

Name: git.terminalGitEditor
Desc: Controls whether to enable VS Code to be the Git editor for Git processes spawned in the integrated terminal. Note: Terminals need to be restarted to pick up a change in this setting.

Name: git.timeline.date
Desc: Controls which date to use for items in the Timeline view. - committed: Use the committed date - authored: Use the authored date

Name: git.timeline.showAuthor
Desc: Controls whether to show the commit author in the Timeline view.

Name: git.timeline.showUncommitted
Desc: Controls whether to show uncommitted changes in the Timeline view.

Name: git.untrackedChanges
Desc: Controls how untracked changes behave. - mixed: All changes, tracked and untracked, appear together and behave equally. - separate: Untracked changes appear separately in the Source Control view. They are also excluded from several actions. - hidden: Untracked changes are hidden and excluded from several actions.

Name: git.useCommitInputAsStashMessage
Desc: Controls whether to use the message from the commit input box as the default stash message.

Name: git.useEditorAsCommitInput
Desc: Controls whether a full text editor will be used to author commit messages, whenever no message is provided in the commit input box.

Name: git.useForcePushIfIncludes
Desc: Controls whether force pushing uses the safer force-if-includes variant. Note: This setting requires the `git.useForcePushWithLease` setting to be enabled, and Git version `2.30.0` or later.

Name: git.useForcePushWithLease
Desc: Controls whether force pushing uses the safer force-with-lease variant.

Name: git.useIntegratedAskPass
Desc: Controls whether GIT_ASKPASS should be overwritten to use the integrated version.

Name: git.verboseCommit
Desc: Enable verbose output when `git.useEditorAsCommitInput` is enabled.

Name: git.worktreeIncludeFiles
Desc: Configure [glob patterns](https://aka.ms/vscode-glob-patterns) for files and folders that are included when creating a new worktree. Only files and folders that match the patterns and are listed in `.gitignore` will be copied to the newly created worktree.

Name: github.copilot.chat.agent.terminal.allowList
Desc: Use `chat.tools.terminal.autoApprove` instead

Name: github.copilot.chat.agent.terminal.denyList
Desc: Use `chat.tools.terminal.autoApprove` instead

Name: github.branchProtection
Desc: Controls whether to query repository rules for GitHub repositories

Name: github.gitAuthentication
Desc: Controls whether to enable automatic GitHub authentication for git commands within VS Code.

Name: github.gitProtocol
Desc: Controls which protocol is used to clone a GitHub repository

Name: github.showAvatar
Desc: Controls whether to show the GitHub avatar of the commit author in various hovers (ex: Git blame, Timeline, Source Control Graph, etc.)

Name: github-authentication.preferDeviceCodeFlow
Desc: GHE.com & GitHub Enterprise Server Authentication When true, prioritize the device code flow for authentication instead of other available flows. This is useful for environments like WSL where the local server or URL handler flows may not work as expected.

Name: github-authentication.useElectronFetch
Desc: When true, uses Electron's built-in fetch function for HTTP requests. When false, uses the Node.js global fetch function. This setting only applies when running in the Electron environment. **Note:** A restart is required for this setting to take effect.

Name: github-enterprise.uri
Desc: The URI for your GHE.com or GitHub Enterprise Server instance. * GHE.com: `https://octocat.ghe.com` * GitHub Enterprise Server: `https://github.octocat.com` > **Note:** This should _not_ be set to a GitHub.com URI. If your account exists on GitHub.com or is a GitHub Enterprise Managed User, you do not need any additional configuration and can simply log in to GitHub.

Name: grunt.autoDetect
Desc: Controls enablement of Grunt task detection. Grunt task detection can cause files in any open workspace to be executed.

Name: gulp.autoDetect
Desc: Controls enablement of Gulp task detection. Gulp task detection can cause files in any open workspace to be executed.

Name: html.autoClosingTags
Desc: Enable/disable autoclosing of HTML tags.

Name: html.autoCreateQuotes
Desc: Enable/disable auto creation of quotes for HTML attribute assignment. The type of quotes can be configured by `html.completion.attributeDefaultValue`.

Name: html.completion.attributeDefaultValue
Desc: Controls the default value for attributes when completion is accepted. - doublequotes: Attribute value is set to "". - singlequotes: Attribute value is set to ''. - empty: Attribute value is not set.

Name: html.customData
Desc: A list of relative file paths pointing to JSON files following the [custom data format](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode-html-languageservice/blob/master/docs/customData.md). VS Code loads custom data on startup to enhance its HTML support for the custom HTML tags, attributes and attribute values you specify in the JSON files. The file paths are relative to workspace and only workspace folder settings are considered.

Name: html.format.contentUnformatted
Desc: List of tags, comma separated, where the content shouldn't be reformatted. `null` defaults to the `pre` tag.

Name: html.format.enable
Desc: Enable/disable default HTML formatter.

Name: html.format.extraLiners
Desc: List of tags, comma separated, that should have an extra newline before them. `null` defaults to `"head, body, /html"`.

Name: html.format.indentHandlebars
Desc: Format and indent `{{#foo}}` and `{{/foo}}`.

Name: html.format.indentInnerHtml
Desc: Indent `<head>` and `<body>` sections.

Name: html.format.maxPreserveNewLines
Desc: Maximum number of line breaks to be preserved in one chunk. Use `null` for unlimited.

Name: html.format.preserveNewLines
Desc: Controls whether existing line breaks before elements should be preserved. Only works before elements, not inside tags or for text.

Name: html.format.templating
Desc: Honor django, erb, handlebars and php templating language tags.

Name: html.format.unformatted
Desc: List of tags, comma separated, that shouldn't be reformatted. `null` defaults to all tags listed at https://www.w3.org/TR/html5/dom.html#phrasing-content.

Name: html.format.unformattedContentDelimiter
Desc: Keep text content together between this string.

Name: html.format.wrapAttributes
Desc: Wrap attributes. - auto: Wrap attributes only when line length is exceeded. - force: Wrap each attribute except first. - force-aligned: Wrap each attribute except first and keep aligned. - force-expand-multiline: Wrap each attribute. - aligned-multiple: Wrap when line length is exceeded, align attributes vertically. - preserve: Preserve wrapping of attributes. - preserve-aligned: Preserve wrapping of attributes but align.

Name: html.format.wrapAttributesIndentSize
Desc: Indent wrapped attributes to after N characters. Use `null` to use the default indent size. Ignored if `html.format.wrapAttributes` is set to `aligned`.

Name: html.format.wrapLineLength
Desc: Maximum amount of characters per line (0 = disable).

Name: html.hover.documentation
Desc: Show tag and attribute documentation in hover.

Name: html.hover.references
Desc: Show references to MDN in hover.

Name: html.mirrorCursorOnMatchingTag
Desc: Deprecated in favor of `editor.linkedEditing` Enable/disable mirroring cursor on matching HTML tag.

Name: html.suggest.hideEndTagSuggestions
Desc: Controls whether the built-in HTML language support suggests closing tags. When disabled, end tag completions like `` will not be shown.

Name: html.suggest.html5
Desc: Controls whether the built-in HTML language support suggests HTML5 tags, properties and values.

Name: html.trace.server
Desc: Traces the communication between VS Code and the HTML language server.

Name: html.validate.scripts
Desc: Controls whether the built-in HTML language support validates embedded scripts.

Name: html.validate.styles
Desc: Controls whether the built-in HTML language support validates embedded styles.

Name: http.electronFetch
Desc: Controls whether use of Electron's fetch implementation instead of Node.js' should be enabled. All local extensions will get Electron's fetch implementation for the global fetch API.

Name: http.experimental.networkInterfaceCheckInterval
Desc: Controls the interval in seconds for checking network interface changes to invalidate the proxy cache. Set to -1 to disable. When during [remote development](https://aka.ms/vscode-remote) the `http.useLocalProxyConfiguration` setting is disabled this setting can be configured in the local and the remote settings separately.

Name: http.experimental.systemCertificatesV2
Desc: Controls whether experimental loading of CA certificates from the OS should be enabled. This uses a more general approach than the default implementation. When during [remote development](https://aka.ms/vscode-remote) the `http.useLocalProxyConfiguration` setting is disabled this setting can be configured in the local and the remote settings separately.

Name: http.fetchAdditionalSupport
Desc: Controls whether Node.js' fetch implementation should be extended with additional support. Currently proxy support (`http.proxySupport`) and system certificates (`http.systemCertificates`) are added when the corresponding settings are enabled. When during [remote development](https://aka.ms/vscode-remote) the `http.useLocalProxyConfiguration` setting is disabled this setting can be configured in the local and the remote settings separately.

Name: http.noProxy
Desc: Specifies domain names for which proxy settings should be ignored for HTTP/HTTPS requests. When during [remote development](https://aka.ms/vscode-remote) the `http.useLocalProxyConfiguration` setting is disabled this setting can be configured in the local and the remote settings separately.

Name: http.proxy
Desc: The proxy setting to use. If not set, will be inherited from the `http_proxy` and `https_proxy` environment variables. When during [remote development](https://aka.ms/vscode-remote) the `http.useLocalProxyConfiguration` setting is disabled this setting can be configured in the local and the remote settings separately.

Name: http.proxyAuthorization
Desc: The value to send as the `Proxy-Authorization` header for every network request. When during [remote development](https://aka.ms/vscode-remote) the `http.useLocalProxyConfiguration` setting is disabled this setting can be configured in the local and the remote settings separately.

Name: http.proxyKerberosServicePrincipal
Desc: Overrides the principal service name for Kerberos authentication with the HTTP proxy. A default based on the proxy hostname is used when this is not set. When during [remote development](https://aka.ms/vscode-remote) the `http.useLocalProxyConfiguration` setting is disabled this setting can be configured in the local and the remote settings separately.

Name: http.proxyStrictSSL
Desc: Controls whether the proxy server certificate should be verified against the list of supplied CAs. When during [remote development](https://aka.ms/vscode-remote) the `http.useLocalProxyConfiguration` setting is disabled this setting can be configured in the local and the remote settings separately.

Name: http.proxySupport
Desc: Use the proxy support for extensions. When during [remote development](https://aka.ms/vscode-remote) the `http.useLocalProxyConfiguration` setting is disabled this setting can be configured in the local and the remote settings separately. - off: Disable proxy support for extensions. - on: Enable proxy support for extensions. - fallback: Enable proxy support for extensions, fall back to request options, when no proxy found. - override: Enable proxy support for extensions, override request options.

Name: http.systemCertificates
Desc: Controls whether CA certificates should be loaded from the OS. On Windows and macOS, a reload of the window is required after turning this off. When during [remote development](https://aka.ms/vscode-remote) the `http.useLocalProxyConfiguration` setting is disabled this setting can be configured in the local and the remote settings separately.

Name: http.systemCertificatesNode
Desc: Controls whether system certificates should be loaded using Node.js built-in support. Reload the window after changing this setting. When during [remote development](https://aka.ms/vscode-remote) the `http.useLocalProxyConfiguration` setting is disabled this setting can be configured in the local and the remote settings separately.

Name: http.useLocalProxyConfiguration
Desc: Controls whether in the remote extension host the local proxy configuration should be used. This setting only applies as a remote setting during [remote development](https://aka.ms/vscode-remote).

Name: http.webSocketAdditionalSupport
Desc: Controls whether the built-in WebSocket implementation should be extended with additional support. Currently proxy support (`http.proxySupport`) and system certificates (`http.systemCertificates`) are added when the corresponding settings are enabled. When during [remote development](https://aka.ms/vscode-remote) the `http.useLocalProxyConfiguration` setting is disabled this setting can be configured in the local and the remote settings separately.

Name: imageCarousel.chat.enabled
Desc: Controls whether clicking an image attachment in chat opens the Images Preview viewer.

Name: imageCarousel.explorerContextMenu.enabled
Desc: Controls whether the **Open in Images Preview** option appears in the Explorer context menu.

Name: inlineChat.defaultModel
Desc: Select the default language model to use for inline chat from the available providers. Model names may include the provider in parentheses, for example 'Claude Haiku 4.5 (copilot)'. - : Use the vendor's default model

Name: inlineChat.affordance
Desc: Controls whether an inline chat affordance is shown when text is selected. - off: No affordance is shown. - editor: Show an affordance in the editor at the cursor position.

Name: inlineChat.askInChat
Desc: Controls whether files in a chat editing session use Ask in Chat instead of Inline Chat.

Name: inlineChat.fixDiagnostics
Desc: Controls whether the Fix action is shown for diagnostics in the editor.

Name: inlineChat.notebookAgent
Desc: Enable agent-like behavior for inline chat widget in notebooks.

Name: interactiveWindow.alwaysScrollOnNewCell
Desc: Automatically scroll the interactive window to show the output of the last statement executed. If this value is false, the window will only scroll if the last cell was already the one scrolled to.

Name: interactiveWindow.executeWithShiftEnter
Desc: Execute the Interactive Window (REPL) input box with shift+enter, so that enter can be used to create a newline.

Name: interactiveWindow.promptToSaveOnClose
Desc: Prompt to save the interactive window when it is closed. Only new interactive windows will be affected by this setting change.

Name: interactiveWindow.showExecutionHint
Desc: Display a hint in the Interactive Window (REPL) input box to indicate how to execute code.

Name: interactiveWindow.collapseCellInputCode
Desc: Controls whether code cells in the interactive window are collapsed by default.

Name: ipynb.experimental.serialization
Desc: Experimental feature to serialize the Jupyter notebook in a worker thread.

Name: ipynb.pasteImagesAsAttachments.enabled
Desc: Enable/disable pasting of images into Markdown cells in ipynb notebook files. Pasted images are inserted as attachments to the cell.

Name: issueReporter.wizard.enabled
Desc: Enable the new issue reporter wizard instead of the classic issue reporter.

Name: issueReporter.wizard.fullWorkspaceScan
Desc: When auto-collecting performance diagnostics for the issue reporter wizard, walk the full workspace instead of stopping at the default 20,000-file cap. Set to false on very large workspaces if the scan slows the initial wizard render.

Name: jake.autoDetect
Desc: Controls enablement of Jake task detection. Jake task detection can cause files in any open workspace to be executed.

Name: javascript.preferences.autoImportFileExcludePatterns
Desc: This setting is deprecated. Use `js/ts.preferences.autoImportFileExcludePatterns` instead. Specify glob patterns of files to exclude from auto imports. Relative paths are resolved relative to the workspace root. Patterns are evaluated using tsconfig.json [`exclude`](https://www.typescriptlang.org/tsconfig#exclude) semantics.

Name: javascript.preferences.autoImportSpecifierExcludeRegexes
Desc: This setting is deprecated. Use `js/ts.preferences.autoImportSpecifierExcludeRegexes` instead. Specify regular expressions to exclude auto imports with matching import specifiers. Examples: - `^node:` - `lib/internal` (slashes don't need to be escaped...) - `/lib\/internal/i` (...unless including surrounding slashes for `i` or `u` flags) - `^lodash$` (only allow subpath imports from lodash)

Name: javascript.preferences.importModuleSpecifier
Desc: This setting is deprecated. Use `js/ts.preferences.importModuleSpecifier` instead. Preferred path style for auto imports. - shortest: Prefers a non-relative import only if one is available that has fewer path segments than a relative import. - relative: Prefers a relative path to the imported file location. - non-relative: Prefers a non-relative import based on the `baseUrl` or `paths` configured in your `jsconfig.json` / `tsconfig.json`. - project-relative: Prefers a non-relative import only if the relative import path would leave the package or project directory.

Name: javascript.preferences.importModuleSpecifierEnding
Desc: This setting is deprecated. Use `js/ts.preferences.importModuleSpecifierEnding` instead. Preferred path ending for auto imports. - auto: Use project settings to select a default. - minimal: Shorten `./component/index.js` to `./component`. - index: Shorten `./component/index.js` to `./component/index`. - js: Do not shorten path endings; include the `.js` or `.ts` extension.

Name: javascript.preferences.jsxAttributeCompletionStyle

Preferred style for JSX attribute completions. - auto: Insert `={}` or `=""` after attribute names based on the prop type. See `javascript.preferences.quoteStyle` to control the type of quotes used for string attributes. - braces: Insert `={}` after attribute names. - none: Only insert attribute names.

Name: javascript.preferences.quoteStyle

Name: javascript.suggest.paths

Name: javascript.referencesCodeLens.enabled

Name: javascript.referencesCodeLens.showOnAllFunctions
Desc: This setting is deprecated. Use `js/ts.referencesCodeLens.showOnAllFunctions` instead. Enable/disable the [references CodeLens](#js/ts.referencesCodeLens.enabled) on all functions in JavaScript and TypeScript files.

Name: javascript.inlayHints.parameterNames.enabled
Desc: This setting is deprecated. Use `js/ts.inlayHints.parameterNames.enabled` instead. Enable/disable inlay hints for parameter names: parseInt(/* str: */ '123', /* radix: */ 8) - none: Disable parameter name hints. - literals: Enable parameter name hints only for literal arguments. - all: Enable parameter name hints for literal and non-literal arguments.

Name: javascript.inlayHints.parameterNames.suppressWhenArgumentMatchesName
Desc: This setting is deprecated. Use `js/ts.inlayHints.parameterNames.suppressWhenArgumentMatchesName` instead. Suppress parameter name hints on arguments whose text is identical to the parameter name.

Name: javascript.inlayHints.parameterTypes.enabled
Desc: This setting is deprecated. Use `js/ts.inlayHints.parameterTypes.enabled` instead. Enable/disable inlay hints for implicit parameter types: el.addEventListener('click', e /* :MouseEvent */ => ...)

Name: javascript.inlayHints.propertyDeclarationTypes.enabled
Desc: This setting is deprecated. Use `js/ts.inlayHints.propertyDeclarationTypes.enabled` instead. Enable/disable inlay hints for implicit types on property declarations: prop /* :number */ = Date.now();

Name: javascript.inlayHints.variableTypes.enabled
Desc: This setting is deprecated. Use `js/ts.inlayHints.variableTypes.enabled` instead. Enable/disable inlay hints for implicit variable types: const foo /* :number */ = Date.now();

Name: javascript.inlayHints.variableTypes.suppressWhenTypeMatchesName
Desc: This setting is deprecated. Use `js/ts.inlayHints.variableTypes.suppressWhenTypeMatchesName` instead. Suppress type hints on variables whose name is identical to the type name.

Name: js/ts.experimental.useTsgo
Desc: JavaScript and TypeScript Language Features Disables TypeScript and JavaScript language features to allow usage of the TypeScript Go experimental extension. Requires TypeScript Go to be installed and configured. Requires reloading extensions after changing this setting.

Name: js/ts.locale
Desc: Sets the locale used to report JavaScript and TypeScript errors. Defaults to use VS Code's locale. - auto: Use VS Code's configured display language. - de: Deutsch - es: español - en: English - fr: français - it: italiano - ja: 日本語 - ko: 한국어 - ru: русский - zh-CN: 中文(简体) - zh-TW: 中文(繁體)

Name: js/ts.tsc.autoDetect
Desc: Controls auto detection of tsc tasks. - on: Create both build and watch tasks. - off: Disable this feature. - build: Only create single run compile tasks. - watch: Only create compile and watch tasks.

Name: js/ts.tsdk.path
Desc: Specifies the folder path to the tsserver and `lib*.d.ts` files under a TypeScript install to use for IntelliSense, for example: `./node_modules/typescript/lib`. - When specified as a user setting, the TypeScript version from `js/ts.tsdk.path` automatically replaces the built-in TypeScript version. - When specified as a workspace setting, `js/ts.tsdk.path` allows you to switch to use that workspace version of TypeScript for IntelliSense with the `TypeScript: Select TypeScript version` command. See the [TypeScript documentation](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/typescript/typescript-compiling#_using-newer-typescript-versions) for more detail about managing TypeScript versions.

Name: js/ts.preferences.autoImportFileExcludePatterns
Desc: Specify glob patterns of files to exclude from auto imports. Relative paths are resolved relative to the workspace root. Patterns are evaluated using tsconfig.json [`exclude`](https://www.typescriptlang.org/tsconfig#exclude) semantics.

Desc: Specify regular expressions to exclude auto imports with matching import specifiers. Examples: - `^node:` - `lib/internal` (slashes don't need to be escaped...) - `/lib\/internal/i` (...unless including surrounding slashes for `i` or `u` flags) - `^lodash$` (only allow subpath imports from lodash)

Name: js/ts.preferences.importModuleSpecifier
Desc: Preferred path style for auto imports. - shortest: Prefers a non-relative import only if one is available that has fewer path segments than a relative import. - relative: Prefers a relative path to the imported file location. - non-relative: Prefers a non-relative import based on the `baseUrl` or `paths` configured in your `jsconfig.json` / `tsconfig.json`. - project-relative: Prefers a non-relative import only if the relative import path would leave the package or project directory.

Name: js/ts.preferences.includePackageJsonAutoImports
Desc: Enable/disable searching `package.json` dependencies for available auto imports. - auto: Search dependencies based on estimated performance impact. - on: Always search dependencies. - off: Never search dependencies.

Name: js/ts.preferences.jsxAttributeCompletionStyle

See `js/ts.preferences.quoteStyle` to control the type of quotes used for string attributes. - braces: Insert `={}` after attribute names. - none: Only insert attribute names.
