Desc: Enable/disable showing [implementations CodeLens](#js/ts.implementationsCodeLens.enabled) above all TypeScript class methods instead of only on abstract methods.

Name: js/ts.implementationsCodeLens.showOnInterfaceMethods
Desc: Enable/disable [implementations CodeLens](#js/ts.implementationsCodeLens.enabled) on TypeScript interface methods.

Name: js/ts.referencesCodeLens.enabled
Desc: Enable/disable references CodeLens in JavaScript and TypeScript files. This CodeLens shows the number of references for classes and exported functions and allows you to peek or navigate to them.

Name: js/ts.referencesCodeLens.showOnAllFunctions
Desc: Enable/disable the [references CodeLens](#js/ts.referencesCodeLens.enabled) on all functions in JavaScript and TypeScript files.

Name: js/ts.inlayHints.enumMemberValues.enabled
Desc: Enable/disable inlay hints for member values in enum declarations:

Name: js/ts.inlayHints.functionLikeReturnTypes.enabled
Desc: Enable/disable inlay hints for implicit return types on function signatures: function foo() /* :number */ {

Name: js/ts.inlayHints.parameterNames.enabled
Desc: Enable/disable inlay hints for parameter names: parseInt(/* str: */ '123', /* radix: */ 8) - none: Disable parameter name hints. - literals: Enable parameter name hints only for literal arguments. - all: Enable parameter name hints for literal and non-literal arguments.

Name: js/ts.inlayHints.parameterNames.suppressWhenArgumentMatchesName
Desc: Suppress parameter name hints on arguments whose text is identical to the parameter name.

Name: js/ts.inlayHints.parameterTypes.enabled
Desc: Enable/disable inlay hints for implicit parameter types: el.addEventListener('click', e /* :MouseEvent */ => ...)

Name: js/ts.inlayHints.propertyDeclarationTypes.enabled
Desc: Enable/disable inlay hints for implicit types on property declarations: prop /* :number */ = Date.now();

Name: js/ts.inlayHints.variableTypes.enabled
Desc: Enable/disable inlay hints for implicit variable types: const foo /* :number */ = Date.now();

Name: js/ts.inlayHints.variableTypes.suppressWhenTypeMatchesName
Desc: Suppress type hints on variables whose name is identical to the type name.

Name: js/ts.tsdk.promptToUseWorkspaceVersion
Desc: TS Server Advanced Settings Enables prompting of users to use the TypeScript version configured in the workspace for Intellisense.

Name: js/ts.tsserver.automaticTypeAcquisition.enabled
Desc: Enable [automatic type acquisition](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/nodejs/working-with-javascript#_typings-and-automatic-type-acquisition). Automatic type acquisition fetches `@types` packages from npm to improve IntelliSense for external libraries.

Name: js/ts.tsserver.checkNpmIsInstalled
Desc: Check if npm is installed for [Automatic Type Acquisition](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/nodejs/working-with-javascript#_typings-and-automatic-type-acquisition).

Name: js/ts.tsserver.diagnosticDir
Desc: Directory where TypeScript server writes Node diagnostic output by passing `--diagnostic-dir`.

Name: js/ts.tsserver.heapProfile
Desc: Configures heap profiling for TypeScript server.

Name: js/ts.tsserver.heapSnapshot
Desc: Controls how many near-heap-limit snapshots TypeScript server writes by passing `--heapsnapshot-near-heap-limit`. Set to `0` to disable.

Name: js/ts.tsserver.log
Desc: Enables logging of the TS server to a file. This log can be used to diagnose TS Server issues. The log may contain file paths, source code, and other potentially sensitive information from your project.

Name: js/ts.tsserver.maxMemory
Desc: The maximum amount of memory (in MB) to allocate to the TypeScript server process. To use a memory limit greater than 4 GB, use `js/ts.tsserver.node.path` to run TS Server with a custom Node installation.

Name: js/ts.tsserver.node.path
Desc: Run TS Server on a custom Node installation. This can be a path to a Node executable, or `node` if you want VS Code to detect a Node installation.

Name: js/ts.tsserver.npm.path
Desc: Specifies the path to the npm executable used for [Automatic Type Acquisition](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/nodejs/working-with-javascript#_typings-and-automatic-type-acquisition).

Name: js/ts.tsserver.pluginPaths
Desc: Additional paths to discover TypeScript Language Service plugins.

Name: js/ts.tsserver.tracing.enabled
Desc: Enables tracing TS server performance to a directory. These trace files can be used to diagnose TS Server performance issues. The log may contain file paths, source code, and other potentially sensitive information from your project.

Name: js/ts.tsserver.useSyntaxServer
Desc: Controls if TypeScript launches a dedicated server to more quickly handle syntax related operations, such as computing code folding. - always: Use a lighter weight syntax server to handle all IntelliSense operations. This disables project-wide features including auto-imports, cross-file completions, and go to definition for symbols in other files. Only use this for very large projects where performance is critical. - never: Don't use a dedicated syntax server. Use a single server to handle all IntelliSense operations. - auto: Spawn both a full server and a lighter weight server dedicated to syntax operations. The syntax server is used to speed up syntax operations and provide IntelliSense while projects are loading.

Name: js/ts.tsserver.watchOptions
Desc: Configure which watching strategies should be used to keep track of files and directories.

Name: js/ts.tsserver.web.projectWideIntellisense.enabled
Desc: Enable/disable project-wide IntelliSense on web. Requires that VS Code is running in a trusted context.

Name: js/ts.tsserver.web.projectWideIntellisense.suppressSemanticErrors
Desc: Suppresses semantic errors on web even when project wide IntelliSense is enabled. This is always on when project wide IntelliSense is not enabled or available. See `js/ts.tsserver.web.projectWideIntellisense.enabled`

Name: js/ts.tsserver.web.typeAcquisition.enabled
Desc: Enable/disable package acquisition on the web. This enables IntelliSense for imported packages. Requires `js/ts.tsserver.web.projectWideIntellisense.enabled`. Currently not supported for Safari.

Name: json.colorDecorators.enable
Desc: The setting `json.colorDecorators.enable` has been deprecated in favor of `editor.colorDecorators`. Enables or disables color decorators

Name: json.format.enable
Desc: Enable/disable default JSON formatter

Name: json.format.keepLines
Desc: Keep all existing new lines when formatting.

Name: json.maxItemsComputed
Desc: The maximum number of outline symbols and folding regions computed (limited for performance reasons).

Name: json.schemaDownload.enable
Desc: When enabled, JSON schemas can be fetched from http and https locations.

Name: json.schemaDownload.trustedDomains
Desc: List of trusted domains for downloading JSON schemas over http(s). Use `*` to trust all domains. `*` can also be used as a wildcard in domain names.

Name: json.schemas
Desc: Associate schemas to JSON files in the current project.

Name: json.trace.server
Desc: Traces the communication between VS Code and the JSON language server.

Name: json.validate.enable
Desc: Enable/disable JSON validation.

Name: jsts-chat-features.skills.enabled
Desc: These skills provide helpful prompts and features to enhance your experience when using Copilot to work with JavaScript and TypeScript.

Name: keyboard.dispatch
Desc: Controls the dispatching logic for key presses to use either `code` (recommended) or `keyCode`.

Name: less.completion.completePropertyWithSemicolon
Desc: Insert semicolon at end of line when completing CSS properties.

Name: less.completion.triggerPropertyValueCompletion
Desc: By default, VS Code triggers property value completion after selecting a CSS property. Use this setting to disable this behavior.

Name: less.format.braceStyle
Desc: Put braces on the same line as rules (`collapse`) or put braces on own line (`expand`).

Name: less.format.enable
Desc: Enable/disable default LESS formatter.

Name: less.format.maxPreserveNewLines
Desc: Maximum number of line breaks to be preserved in one chunk, when `less.format.preserveNewLines` is enabled.

Name: less.format.newlineBetweenRules
Desc: Separate rulesets by a blank line.

Name: less.format.newlineBetweenSelectors
Desc: Separate selectors with a new line.

Name: less.format.preserveNewLines
Desc: Whether existing line breaks before rules and declarations should be preserved.

Name: less.format.spaceAroundSelectorSeparator
Desc: Ensure a space character around selector separators `>`, `+`, `~` (e.g. `a > b`).

Name: less.hover.documentation
Desc: Show property and value documentation in LESS hovers.

Name: less.hover.references
Desc: Show references to MDN in LESS hovers.

Name: less.lint.argumentsInColorFunction
Desc: Invalid number of parameters.

Name: less.lint.boxModel
Desc: Do not use `width` or `height` when using `padding` or `border`.

Name: less.lint.compatibleVendorPrefixes
Desc: When using a vendor-specific prefix make sure to also include all other vendor-specific properties.

Name: less.lint.duplicateProperties
Desc: Do not use duplicate style definitions.

Name: less.lint.emptyRules
Desc: Do not use empty rulesets.

Name: less.lint.float
Desc: Avoid using `float`. Floats lead to fragile CSS that is easy to break if one aspect of the layout changes.

Name: less.lint.fontFaceProperties
Desc: `@font-face` rule must define `src` and `font-family` properties.

Name: less.lint.hexColorLength
Desc: Hex colors must consist of 3, 4, 6 or 8 hex numbers.

Name: less.lint.idSelector
Desc: Selectors should not contain IDs because these rules are too tightly coupled with the HTML.

Name: less.lint.ieHack
Desc: IE hacks are only necessary when supporting IE7 and older.

Name: less.lint.important
Desc: Avoid using `!important`. It is an indication that the specificity of the entire CSS has gotten out of control and needs to be refactored.

Name: less.lint.importStatement
Desc: Import statements do not load in parallel.

Name: less.lint.propertyIgnoredDueToDisplay
Desc: Property is ignored due to the display. E.g. with `display: inline`, the `width`, `height`, `margin-top`, `margin-bottom`, and `float` properties have no effect.

Name: less.lint.universalSelector
Desc: The universal selector (`*`) is known to be slow.

Name: less.lint.unknownAtRules
Desc: Unknown at-rule.

Name: less.lint.unknownProperties
Desc: Unknown property.

Name: less.lint.unknownVendorSpecificProperties
Desc: Unknown vendor specific property.

Name: less.lint.validProperties
Desc: A list of properties that are not validated against the `unknownProperties` rule.

Name: less.lint.vendorPrefix
Desc: When using a vendor-specific prefix, also include the standard property.

Name: less.lint.zeroUnits
Desc: No unit for zero needed.

Name: less.validate
Desc: Enables or disables all validations.

Name: markdown.copyFiles.destination
Desc: Configures the path and file name of files created by copy/paste or drag and drop. This is a map of globs that match against a Markdown document path to the destination path where the new file should be created. The destination path may use the following variables: - `${documentDirName}` — Absolute parent directory path of the Markdown document, e.g. `/Users/me/myProject/docs`. - `${documentRelativeDirName}` — Relative parent directory path of the Markdown document, e.g. `docs`. This is the same as `${documentDirName}` if the file is not part of a workspace. - `${documentFileName}` — The full filename of the Markdown document, e.g. `README.md`. - `${documentBaseName}` — The basename of the Markdown document, e.g. `README`. - `${documentExtName}` — The extension of the Markdown document, e.g. `md`. - `${documentFilePath}` — Absolute path of the Markdown document, e.g. `/Users/me/myProject/docs/README.md`. - `${documentRelativeFilePath}` — Relative path of the Markdown document, e.g. `docs/README.md`. This is the same as `${documentFilePath}` if the file is not part of a workspace. - `${documentWorkspaceFolder}` — The workspace folder for the Markdown document, e.g. `/Users/me/myProject`. This is the same as `${documentDirName}` if the file is not part of a workspace. - `${fileName}` — The file name of the dropped file, e.g. `image.png`. - `${fileExtName}` — The extension of the dropped file, e.g. `png`. - `${unixTime}` — The current Unix timestamp in milliseconds. - `${isoTime}` — The current time in ISO 8601 format, e.g. '2025-06-06T08:40:32.123Z'.

Name: markdown.copyFiles.overwriteBehavior
Desc: Controls if files created by drop or paste should overwrite existing files. - nameIncrementally: If a file with the same name already exists, append a number to the file name, for example: `image.png` becomes `image-1.png`. - overwrite: If a file with the same name already exists, overwrite it.

Name: markdown.editor.drop.copyIntoWorkspace
Desc: Controls if files outside of the workspace that are dropped into a Markdown editor should be copied into the workspace. Use `markdown.copyFiles.destination` to configure where copied dropped files should be created - mediaFiles: Try to copy external image and video files into the workspace. - never: Do not copy external files into the workspace.

Name: markdown.editor.drop.enabled
Desc: Controls whether dropping files into a Markdown editor while holding Shift inserts Markdown links. Requires enabling `editor.dropIntoEditor.enabled`. - always: Always insert Markdown links. - smart: Smartly create Markdown links by default when not dropping into a code block or other special element. Use the drop widget to switch between pasting as plain text or as Markdown links. - never: Never create Markdown links.

Name: markdown.editor.filePaste.audioSnippet
Desc: Snippet used when adding audio to Markdown. This snippet can use the following variables: - `${src}` — The resolved path of the audio  file. - `${title}` — The title used for the audio. A snippet placeholder will automatically be created for this variable.

Name: markdown.editor.filePaste.copyIntoWorkspace
Desc: Controls if files outside of the workspace that are pasted into a Markdown editor should be copied into the workspace. Use `markdown.copyFiles.destination` to configure where copied files should be created. - mediaFiles: Try to copy external image and video files into the workspace. - never: Do not copy external files into the workspace.

Name: markdown.editor.filePaste.enabled
Desc: Controls whether pasting files into a Markdown editor creates Markdown links. Requires enabling `editor.pasteAs.enabled`. - always: Always insert Markdown links. - smart: Smartly create Markdown links by default when not pasting into a code block or other special element. Use the paste widget to switch between pasting as plain text or as Markdown links. - never: Never create Markdown links.

Name: markdown.editor.filePaste.videoSnippet
Desc: Snippet used when adding videos to Markdown. This snippet can use the following variables: - `${src}` — The resolved path of the video file. - `${title}` — The title used for the video. A snippet placeholder will automatically be created for this variable.

Name: markdown.editor.pasteUrlAsFormattedLink.enabled
Desc: Controls if Markdown links are created when URLs are pasted into a Markdown editor. Requires enabling `editor.pasteAs.enabled`. - always: Always insert Markdown links. - smart: Smartly create Markdown links by default when not pasting into a code block or other special element. Use the paste widget to switch between pasting as plain text or as Markdown links. - smartWithSelection: Smartly create Markdown links by default when you have selected text and are not pasting into a code block or other special element. Use the paste widget to switch between pasting as plain text or as Markdown links. - never: Never create Markdown links.

Name: markdown.editor.updateLinksOnPaste.enabled
Desc: Enable/disable a paste option that updates links and reference in text that is copied and pasted between Markdown editors. To use this feature, after pasting text that contains updatable links, just click on the Paste Widget and select `Paste and update pasted links`.

Name: markdown.experimental.richLinks.enabled
Desc: Controls whether supported links in the Markdown editor are rendered as rich links with live metadata. Enabling this may make authenticated requests to services such as GitHub.

Name: markdown.links.openLocation
Desc: Controls where links in Markdown files should be opened. - currentGroup: Open links in the active editor group. - beside: Open links beside the active editor.

Name: markdown.occurrencesHighlight.enabled
Desc: Controls whether link occurrences in the current document are highlighted.

Name: markdown.preferredMdPathExtensionStyle
Desc: Controls if file extensions (for example `.md`) are added or not for links to Markdown files. This setting is used when file paths are added by tooling such as path completions or file renames. - auto: For existing paths, try to maintain the file extension style. For new paths, add file extensions. - includeExtension: Prefer including the file extension. For example, path completions to a file named `file.md` will insert `file.md`. - removeExtension: Prefer removing the file extension. For example, path completions to a file named `file.md` will insert `file` without the `.md`.

Name: markdown.suggest.paths.enabled
Desc: Controls whether path suggestions are shown while writing links in Markdown files.

Name: markdown.suggest.paths.includeWorkspaceHeaderCompletions
Desc: Enable suggestions for headers in other Markdown files in the current workspace. Accepting one of these suggestions inserts the full path to header in that file, for example: `[link text](/path/to/file.md#header)`. - never: Disable workspace header suggestions. - onDoubleHash: Enable workspace header suggestions after typing `` in a path, for example: `[link text](##`. - onSingleOrDoubleHash: Enable workspace header suggestions after typing either `` or `#` in a path, for example: `[link text](#` or `[link text](##`.

Name: markdown.updateLinksOnFileMove.enabled
Desc: Try to update links in Markdown files when a file is renamed/moved in the workspace. Use `markdown.updateLinksOnFileMove.include` to configure which files trigger link updates. - prompt: Prompt on each file move. - always: Always update links automatically. - never: Never try to update link and don't prompt.

Name: markdown.updateLinksOnFileMove.enableForDirectories
Desc: Enable updating links when a directory is moved or renamed in the workspace.

Name: markdown.updateLinksOnFileMove.include
Desc: Glob patterns that specifies files that trigger automatic link updates. See `markdown.updateLinksOnFileMove.enabled` for details about this feature.

Name: markdown.validate.duplicateLinkDefinitions.enabled
Desc: Validate duplicated definitions in the current file.

Name: markdown.validate.enabled
Desc: Controls whether error reporting is enabled in Markdown files.

Name: markdown.validate.fileLinks.enabled
Desc: Controls whether links to other files in Markdown files are validated, for example `[link](/path/to/file.md)`. This checks that the target files exist. Requires enabling `markdown.validate.enabled`.

Name: markdown.validate.fileLinks.markdownFragmentLinks
Desc: Validate the fragment part of links to headers in other files in Markdown files, for example: `[link](/path/to/file.md#header)`. Inherits the setting value from `markdown.validate.fragmentLinks.enabled` by default.

Name: markdown.validate.fragmentLinks.enabled
Desc: Controls whether fragment links to headers in the current Markdown file are validated, for example: `[link](#header)`. Requires enabling `markdown.validate.enabled`.

Name: markdown.validate.ignoredLinks
Desc: Configure links that should not be validated. For example adding `/about` would not validate the link `[about](/about)`, while the glob `/assets/**/*.svg` would let you skip validation for any link to `.svg` files under the `assets` directory.

Name: markdown.validate.referenceLinks.enabled
Desc: Controls whether reference links in Markdown files are validated, for example: `[link][ref]`. Requires enabling `markdown.validate.enabled`.

Name: markdown.validate.unusedLinkDefinitions.enabled
Desc: Validate link definitions that are unused in the current file.

Name: markdown.preview.breaks
Desc:
Sets how line-breaks are rendered in the Markdown preview. Setting it to `true` creates a `
` for newlines inside paragraphs.

Name: markdown.preview.doubleClickToSwitchToEditor
Desc: Double-click in the Markdown preview to switch to the editor.

Name: markdown.preview.fontFamily
Default: "-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe WPC', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, 'Ubuntu', 'Droid Sans', sans-serif"
Desc: Controls the font family used in the Markdown preview.

Name: markdown.preview.fontSize
Desc: Controls the font size in pixels used in the Markdown preview.

Name: markdown.preview.frontMatter
Desc: Controls how YAML frontmatter (delimited by `---`) at the start of a Markdown file is rendered in the preview. - hide: Do not render frontmatter. - codeBlock: Render frontmatter as a code block. - table: Render frontmatter as a table of keys and values.

Name: markdown.preview.lineHeight
Desc: Controls the line height used in the Markdown preview. This number is relative to the font size.

Name: markdown.preview.linkify
Desc: Convert URL-like text to links in the Markdown preview.

Name: markdown.preview.markEditorSelection
Desc: Mark the current editor selection in the Markdown preview.

Name: markdown.preview.openMarkdownLinks
Desc: Controls how links to other Markdown files in the Markdown preview should be opened. - inPreview: Try to open links in the Markdown preview. - inEditor: Try to open links in the editor.

Name: markdown.preview.scrollEditorWithPreview
Desc: When a Markdown preview is scrolled, update the view of the editor.

Name: markdown.preview.scrollPreviewWithEditor
Desc: When a Markdown editor is scrolled, update the view of the preview.

Name: markdown.preview.typographer
Desc: Enable some language-neutral replacement and quotes beautification in the Markdown preview.

Name: markdown.styles
Desc: A list of URLs or local paths to CSS style sheets to use from the Markdown preview. Relative paths are interpreted relative to the folder open in the Explorer. If there is no open folder, they are interpreted relative to the location of the Markdown file. All `\` need to be written as `\\`.

Name: markdown.server.log
Desc: Controls the logging level of the Markdown language server.

Name: markdown.trace.server
Desc: Traces the communication between VS Code and the Markdown language server.

Name: markdown.math.enabled
Desc: Enable/disable rendering math in the built-in Markdown preview.

Name: markdown.math.macros
Desc: A collection of custom macros. Each macro is a key-value pair where the key is a new command name and the value is the expansion of the macro.

Name: markdown-mermaid.controls.show
Desc: Controls showing UI controls on Mermaid diagrams. - never: Never show controls. - onHoverOrFocus: Show zoom controls when hovering over or focusing a diagram. - always: Always show zoom controls.

Name: markdown-mermaid.darkModeTheme
Desc: Default Mermaid theme for dark mode. - vscode: Mermaid theme derived from the current VS Code color theme. - base: Built-in Mermaid theme. The only Mermaid theme that can be customized with theme variables. - forest: Built-in Mermaid theme using shades of green. - dark: Built-in Mermaid theme for dark backgrounds. - default: The default built-in Mermaid theme. Works well with light backgrounds. - neutral: Built-in Mermaid theme using a neutral grayscale palette. Suitable for black and white prints.

Name: markdown-mermaid.languages
Desc: Default languages in Markdown.

Name: markdown-mermaid.lightModeTheme
Desc: Default Mermaid theme for light mode. - vscode: Mermaid theme derived from the current VS Code color theme. - base: Built-in Mermaid theme. The only Mermaid theme that can be customized with theme variables. - forest: Built-in Mermaid theme using shades of green. - dark: Built-in Mermaid theme for dark backgrounds. - default: The default built-in Mermaid theme. Works well with light backgrounds. - neutral: Built-in Mermaid theme using a neutral grayscale palette. Suitable for black and white prints.

Name: markdown-mermaid.maxHeight
Desc: Maximum height for diagrams. Must be a CSS value with units such as `80vh` or `400px`. Leave empty to try to automatically size diagrams based on their content.

Name: markdown-mermaid.maxTextSize
Desc: The maximum allowed size of the user's text diagram.

Name: markdown-mermaid.mouseNavigation.enabled
Desc: Controls when mouse-based navigation is enabled on Mermaid diagrams. - always: Always enable mouse navigation on Mermaid diagrams. - alt: Only enable mouse navigation when holding down Alt (Option on macOS). Gestures such as pinch-to-zoom will still work without Alt. - never: Disable mouse navigation.

Name: markdown-mermaid.resizable
Desc: Allow diagrams to be resized vertically by dragging the bottom edge.

Name: mediaPreview.video.autoPlay
Desc: Start playing videos on mute automatically.

Name: mediaPreview.video.loop
Desc: Loop videos over again automatically.

Name: merge-conflict.autoNavigateNextConflict.enabled
Desc: Whether to automatically navigate to the next merge conflict after resolving a merge conflict.

Name: merge-conflict.codeLens.enabled
Desc: Create a CodeLens for merge conflict blocks within editor.

Name: merge-conflict.decorators.enabled
Desc: Create decorators for merge conflict blocks within editor.

Name: merge-conflict.diffViewPosition
Desc: Controls where the diff view should be opened when comparing changes in merge conflicts. - Current: Open the diff view in the current editor group. - Beside: Open the diff view next to the current editor group. - Below: Open the diff view below the current editor group.

Name: mergeEditor.diffAlgorithm
Desc: - legacy: Uses the legacy diffing algorithm. - advanced: Uses the advanced diffing algorithm. - advanced-external: Uses the advanced diffing algorithm from the external `@vscode/diff` package (pure JavaScript). - advanced-wasm: Uses the advanced diffing algorithm from the external `@vscode/diff` package (WebAssembly).

Name: mergeEditor.showDeletionMarkers
Desc: Controls if deletions in base or one of the inputs should be indicated by a vertical bar.

Name: microsoft-authentication.implementation
Desc: The authentication implementation to use for signing in with a Microsoft account. - msal: Use the Microsoft Authentication Library (MSAL) to sign in with a Microsoft account. - msal-no-broker: Use the Microsoft Authentication Library (MSAL) to sign in with a Microsoft account using a browser. This is useful if you are having issues with the native broker.

Name: microsoft-sovereign-cloud.customEnvironment
Desc: Microsoft Sovereign Cloud The custom configuration for the Sovereign Cloud to use with the Microsoft Sovereign Cloud authentication provider. This along with setting `microsoft-sovereign-cloud.environment` to `custom` is required to use this feature.

Name: microsoft-sovereign-cloud.environment
Desc: The Sovereign Cloud to use for authentication. If you select `custom`, you must also set the `microsoft-sovereign-cloud.customEnvironment` setting. - ChinaCloud: Azure China - USGovernment: Azure US Government - custom: A custom Microsoft Sovereign Cloud

Name: network.meteredConnection
Desc: Controls whether the current network connection should be treated as metered. When metered, automatic updates, extension downloads, and other background network activity will be postponed to reduce data usage. - auto: Automatically detect metered connections using the operating system's network status. - on: Always treat the network connection as metered. Automatic updates and downloads will be postponed. - off: Never treat the network connection as metered.

Name: notebook.codeActionsOnSave
Desc: Run a series of Code Actions for a notebook on save. Code Actions must be specified and the editor must not be shutting down. When `files.autoSave` is set to `afterDelay`, Code Actions will only be run when the file is saved explicitly. Example: `"notebook.source.organizeImports": "explicit"`

Name: notebook.backup.sizeLimit
Desc: The limit of notebook output size in kilobytes (KB) where notebook files will no longer be backed up for hot reload. Use 0 for unlimited.

Name: notebook.breadcrumbs.showCodeCells
Desc: When enabled, notebook breadcrumbs contain code cells.

Name: notebook.cellExecutionTimeVerbosity
Desc: Controls the verbosity of the cell execution time in the cell status bar. - default: The cell execution duration is visible, with advanced information in the hover tooltip. - verbose: The cell last execution timestamp and duration are visible, with advanced information in the hover tooltip.

Name: notebook.cellFailureDiagnostics
Desc: Show available diagnostics for cell failures.

Name: notebook.cellFocusIndicator
Desc: Controls where the focus indicator is rendered, either along the cell borders or on the left gutter.

Name: notebook.cellToolbarLocation
Desc: Where the cell toolbar should be shown, or whether it should be hidden.

Name: notebook.cellToolbarVisibility
Desc: Whether the cell toolbar should appear on hover or click.

Name: notebook.compactView
Desc: Control whether the notebook editor should be rendered in a compact form. For example, when turned on, it will decrease the left margin width.

Name: notebook.confirmDeleteRunningCell
Desc: Control whether a confirmation prompt is required to delete a running cell.

Name: notebook.consolidatedOutputButton
Desc: Control whether outputs action should be rendered in the output toolbar.

Name: notebook.consolidatedRunButton
Desc: Control whether extra actions are shown in a dropdown next to the run button.

Name: notebook.defaultFormatter
Desc: Defines a default notebook formatter which takes precedence over all other formatter settings. Must be the identifier of an extension contributing a formatter.

Name: notebook.diff.enablePreview
Desc: Whether to use the enhanced text diff editor for notebook.

Name: notebook.diff.experimental.toggleInline
Desc: Enable the command to toggle the experimental notebook inline diff editor.

Name: notebook.diff.ignoreMetadata
Desc: Hide Metadata Differences

Name: notebook.diff.overviewRuler
Desc: Whether to render the overview ruler in the diff editor for notebook.

Name: notebook.displayOrder
Desc: Priority list for output mime types

Name: notebook.dragAndDropEnabled
Desc: Control whether the notebook editor should allow moving cells through drag and drop.

Name: notebook.editorOptionsCustomizations
Desc: Settings for code editors used in notebooks. This can be used to customize most editor.* settings.

Name: notebook.experimental.generate
Desc: Enable experimental generate action to create code cell with inline chat enabled.

Name: notebook.experimental.remoteSave
Desc: Enables the incremental saving of notebooks between processes and across Remote connections. When enabled, only the changes to the notebook are sent to the extension host, improving performance for large notebooks and slow network connections.

Name: notebook.find.filters
Desc: Customize the Find Widget behavior for searching within notebook cells. When both markup source and markup preview are enabled, the Find Widget will search either the source code or preview based on the current state of the cell.

Name: notebook.formatOnCellExecution
Desc: Format a notebook cell upon execution. A formatter must be available.

Name: notebook.formatOnSave.enabled
Desc: Format a notebook on save. A formatter must be available and the editor must not be shutting down. When `files.autoSave` is set to `afterDelay`, the file will only be formatted when saved explicitly.

Name: notebook.globalToolbar
Desc: Control whether to render a global toolbar inside the notebook editor.

Name: notebook.globalToolbarShowLabel
Desc: Control whether the actions on the notebook toolbar should render label or not.

Name: notebook.gotoSymbols.showAllSymbols
Desc: When enabled, the Go to Symbol Quick Pick will display full code symbols from the notebook, as well as Markdown headers.

Name: notebook.inlineValues
Desc: Control whether to show inline values within notebook code cells after cell execution. Values will remain until the cell is edited, re-executed, or explicitly cleared via the Clear All Outputs toolbar button or the `Notebook: Clear Inline Values` command. - on: Always show inline values, with a regex fallback if no inline value provider is registered. Note: There may be a performance impact in larger cells if the fallback is used. - auto: Show inline values only when an inline value provider is registered. - off: Never show inline values.

Name: notebook.insertFinalNewline
Desc: When enabled, insert a final new line into the end of code cells when saving a notebook.

Name: notebook.insertToolbarLocation
Desc: Control where the insert cell actions should appear. - betweenCells: A toolbar that appears on hover between cells. - notebookToolbar: The toolbar at the top of the notebook editor. - both: Both toolbars. - hidden: The insert actions don't appear anywhere.

Name: notebook.lineNumbers
Desc: Controls the display of line numbers in the cell editor.

Name: notebook.markdown.lineHeight
Desc: Controls the line height in pixels of markdown cells in notebooks. When set to `0`, `normal` will be used

Name: notebook.markup.fontFamily
Desc: Controls the font family of rendered markup in notebooks. When left blank, this will fall back to the default workbench font family.

Name: notebook.markup.fontSize
Desc: Controls the font size in pixels of rendered markup in notebooks. When set to `0`, 120% of `editor.fontSize` is used.

Name: notebook.multiCursor.enabled
Desc: Experimental. Enables a limited set of multi cursor controls across multiple cells in the notebook editor. Currently supported are core editor actions (typing/cut/copy/paste/composition) and a limited subset of editor commands.

Name: notebook.navigation.allowNavigateToSurroundingCells
Desc: When enabled cursor can navigate to the next/previous cell when the current cursor in the cell editor is at the first/last line.

Name: notebook.outline.showCodeCells
Desc: When enabled, notebook outline shows code cells.

Name: notebook.outline.showCodeCellSymbols
Desc: When enabled, notebook outline shows code cell symbols. Relies on `notebook.outline.showCodeCells` being enabled.

Name: notebook.outline.showMarkdownHeadersOnly
Desc: When enabled, notebook outline will show only markdown cells containing a header.

Name: notebook.output.fontFamily
Desc: The font family of the output text within notebook cells. When set to empty, the `editor.fontFamily` is used.

Name: notebook.output.fontSize
Desc: Font size for the output text within notebook cells. When set to 0, `editor.fontSize` is used.

Name: notebook.output.lineHeight
Desc: Line height of the output text within notebook cells. - When set to 0, editor line height is used. - Values between 0 and 8 will be used as a multiplier with the font size. - Values greater than or equal to 8 will be used as effective values.

Name: notebook.output.linkifyFilePaths
Desc: Control whether to disable filepath links in the output of notebook cells.

Name: notebook.output.minimalErrorRendering
Desc: Control whether to render error output in a minimal style.

Name: notebook.output.scrolling
Desc: Initially render notebook outputs in a scrollable region when longer than the limit.

Name: notebook.output.textLineLimit
Desc: Controls how many lines of text are displayed in a text output. If `notebook.output.scrolling` is enabled, this setting is used to determine the scroll height of the output.

Name: notebook.output.wordWrap
Desc: Controls whether the lines in output should wrap.

Name: notebook.scrolling.revealNextCellOnExecute
Desc: How far to scroll when revealing the next cell upon running notebook.cell.executeAndSelectBelow. - fullCell: Scroll to fully reveal the next cell. - firstLine: Scroll to reveal the first line of the next cell. - none: Do not scroll.

Name: notebook.showCellStatusBar
Desc: Whether the cell status bar should be shown. - hidden: The cell status bar is always hidden. - visible: The cell status bar is always visible. - visibleAfterExecute: The cell status bar is hidden until the cell has executed. Then it becomes visible to show the execution status.

Name: notebook.showFoldingControls
Desc: Controls when the Markdown header folding arrow is shown. - always: The folding controls are always visible. - never: Never show the folding controls and reduce the gutter size. - mouseover: The folding controls are visible only on mouseover.

Name: notebook.stickyScroll.enabled
Desc: Experimental. Control whether to render notebook Sticky Scroll headers in the notebook editor.

Name: notebook.stickyScroll.mode
Desc: Control whether nested sticky lines appear to stack flat or indented. - flat: Nested sticky lines appear flat. - indented: Nested sticky lines appear indented.

Name: notebook.undoRedoPerCell
Desc: Whether to use separate undo/redo stack for each cell.

Name: notebook.variablesView
Desc: Enable the experimental notebook variables view within the debug panel.

Name: npm.autoDetect
Desc: Controls whether npm scripts should be automatically detected.

Name: npm.enableRunFromFolder
Desc: Enable running npm scripts contained in a folder from the Explorer context menu.

Name: npm.enableScriptExplorer
Desc: The NPM Script Explorer is now available in 'Views' menu in the Explorer in all folders. Enable an explorer view for npm scripts when there is no top-level `package.json` file.

Name: npm.exclude
Desc: Configure glob patterns for folders that should be excluded from automatic script detection.

Name: npm.fetchOnlinePackageInfo
Desc: Fetch data from https://registry.npmjs.org and https://registry.bower.io to provide auto-completion and information on hover features on npm dependencies.

Name: npm.packageManager
Desc: The package manager used to install dependencies. - auto: Auto-detect which package manager to use based on lock files and installed package managers. - npm: Use npm as the package manager. - yarn: Use yarn as the package manager. - pnpm: Use pnpm as the package manager. - bun: Use bun as the package manager.

Name: npm.runSilent
Desc: Run npm commands with the `--silent` option.

Name: npm.scriptExplorerAction
Desc: The default click action used in the NPM Scripts Explorer: `open` or `run`, the default is `open`.

Name: npm.scriptExplorerExclude
Desc: An array of regular expressions that indicate which scripts should be excluded from the NPM Scripts view.

Name: npm.scriptHover
Desc: Display hover with `Run` and `Debug` commands for scripts.

Name: npm.scriptRunner
Desc: The script runner used to run scripts. - auto: Auto-detect which script runner to use based on lock files and installed package managers. - npm: Use npm as the script runner. - yarn: Use yarn as the script runner. - pnpm: Use pnpm as the script runner. - bun: Use bun as the script runner. - node: Use Node.js as the script runner. - vp: Use Vite+ (vp) as the script runner.

Name: onboarding.developerMode
Desc: Map of onboarding scenario/tour id to whether developer mode is enabled for it. When enabled for a scenario, that onboarding tour ignores usage-based eligibility checks (such as how many sessions you have started), previously persisted shown state, and any linked experiment (so it is shown even if the experiment is not running or you are in the control group). It does not override the `onboarding.enabled` setting. The tour is still shown at most once per window session, so reload the window to show it again.

Name: onboarding.developerModeVariations
Desc: Map of onboarding scenario/tour id to the variation used while developer mode is enabled for that scenario. An empty value uses the experiment-selected or default variation.

Name: onboarding.enabled
Desc: When enabled, onboarding tours and hints may appear automatically to highlight features. Disabling this does not affect tours you start manually.

Name: outline.collapseItems
Desc: Controls whether Outline items are collapsed or expanded. - alwaysCollapse: Collapse all items. - alwaysExpand: Expand all items.

Name: outline.icons
Desc: Render Outline elements with icons.

Name: outline.problems.badges
Desc: Use badges for errors and warnings on Outline elements. Overwritten by `problems.visibility` when it is off.

Name: outline.problems.colors
Desc: Use colors for errors and warnings on Outline elements. Overwritten by `problems.visibility` when it is off.

Name: outline.problems.enabled
Desc: Show errors and warnings on Outline elements. Overwritten by `problems.visibility` when it is off.

Name: outline.showArrays
Desc: When enabled, Outline shows `array`-symbols.

Name: outline.showBooleans
Desc: When enabled, Outline shows `boolean`-symbols.

Name: outline.showClasses
Desc: When enabled, Outline shows `class`-symbols.

Name: outline.showConstants
Desc: When enabled, Outline shows `constant`-symbols.

Name: outline.showConstructors
Desc: When enabled, Outline shows `constructor`-symbols.

Name: outline.showEnumMembers
Desc: When enabled, Outline shows `enumMember`-symbols.

Name: outline.showEnums
Desc: When enabled, Outline shows `enum`-symbols.

Name: outline.showEvents
Desc: When enabled, Outline shows `event`-symbols.

Name: outline.showFields
Desc: When enabled, Outline shows `field`-symbols.

Name: outline.showFiles
Desc: When enabled, Outline shows `file`-symbols.

Name: outline.showFunctions
Desc: When enabled, Outline shows `function`-symbols.

Name: outline.showInterfaces
Desc: When enabled, Outline shows `interface`-symbols.

Name: outline.showKeys
Desc: When enabled, Outline shows `key`-symbols.

Name: outline.showMethods
Desc: When enabled, Outline shows `method`-symbols.

Name: outline.showModules
Desc: When enabled, Outline shows `module`-symbols.

Name: outline.showNamespaces
Desc: When enabled, Outline shows `namespace`-symbols.

Name: outline.showNull
Desc: When enabled, Outline shows `null`-symbols.

Name: outline.showNumbers
Desc: When enabled, Outline shows `number`-symbols.

Name: outline.showObjects
Desc: When enabled, Outline shows `object`-symbols.

Name: outline.showOperators
Desc: When enabled, Outline shows `operator`-symbols.

Name: outline.showPackages
Desc: When enabled, Outline shows `package`-symbols.

Name: outline.showProperties
Desc: When enabled, Outline shows `property`-symbols.

Name: outline.showStrings
Desc: When enabled, Outline shows `string`-symbols.

Name: outline.showStructs
Desc: When enabled, Outline shows `struct`-symbols.

Name: outline.showTypeParameters
Desc: When enabled, Outline shows `typeParameter`-symbols.

Name: outline.showVariables
Desc: When enabled, Outline shows `variable`-symbols.

Name: output.smartScroll.enabled
Desc: Enable/disable the ability of smart scrolling in the output view. Smart scrolling allows you to lock scrolling automatically when you click in the output view and unlocks when you click in the last line.

Name: php.suggest.basic
Desc: Controls whether the built-in PHP language suggestions are enabled. The support suggests PHP globals and variables.

Name: php.validate.enable
Desc: Enable/disable built-in PHP validation.

Name: php.validate.executablePath
Desc: Points to the PHP executable.

Name: php.validate.run
Desc: Whether the linter is run on save or on type.

Name: problems.decorations.enabled
Desc: Show Errors & Warnings on files and folder. Overwritten by `problems.visibility` when it is off.

Name: problems.autoReveal
Desc: Controls whether Problems view should automatically reveal files when opening them.

Name: problems.defaultViewMode
Desc: Controls the default view mode of the Problems view.

Name: problems.showCurrentInStatus
Desc: When enabled shows the current problem in the status bar.

Name: problems.sortOrder
Desc: Controls the order in which problems are navigated. - severity: Navigate problems ordered by severity - position: Navigate problems ordered by position

Name: problems.visibility
Desc: Controls whether the problems are visible throughout the editor and workbench.

Name: references.preferredLocation
Desc: Controls whether 'Peek References' or 'Find References' is invoked when selecting CodeLens references. - peek: Show references in peek editor. - view: Show references in separate view.

Name: remote.autoForwardPorts
Desc: When enabled, new running processes are detected and ports that they listen on are automatically forwarded. Disabling this setting will not prevent all ports from being forwarded. Even when disabled, extensions will still be able to cause ports to be forwarded, and opening some URLs will still cause ports to forwarded. Also see `remote.autoForwardPortsSource`.

Name: remote.autoForwardPortsFallback
Desc: The number of auto forwarded ports that will trigger the switch from `process` to `hybrid` when automatically forwarding ports and `remote.autoForwardPortsSource` is set to `process` by default. Set to `0` to disable the fallback. When `remote.autoForwardPortsFallback` hasn't been configured, but `remote.autoForwardPortsSource` has, `remote.autoForwardPortsFallback` will be treated as though it's set to `0`.

Name: remote.autoForwardPortsSource
Desc: Sets the source from which ports are automatically forwarded when `remote.autoForwardPorts` is true. When `remote.autoForwardPorts` is false, `remote.autoForwardPortsSource` will be used to find information about ports that have already been forwarded. On Windows and macOS remotes, the `process` and `hybrid` options have no effect and `output` will be used. - process: Ports will be automatically forwarded when discovered by watching for processes that are started and include a port. - output: Ports will be automatically forwarded when discovered by reading terminal and debug output. Not all processes that use ports will print to the integrated terminal or debug console, so some ports will be missed. Ports forwarded based on output will not be "un-forwarded" until reload or until the port is closed by the user in the Ports view. - hybrid: Ports will be automatically forwarded when discovered by reading terminal and debug output. Not all processes that use ports will print to the integrated terminal or debug console, so some ports will be missed. Ports will be "un-forwarded" by watching for processes that listen on that port to be terminated.

Name: remote.defaultExtensionsIfInstalledLocally
Desc: List of extensions to install upon connection to a remote when already installed locally.

Name: remote.downloadExtensionsLocally
Desc: When enabled extensions are downloaded locally and installed on remote.

Name: remote.extensionKind
Desc: Override the kind of an extension. `ui` extensions are installed and run on the local machine while `workspace` extensions are run on the remote. By overriding an extension's default kind using this setting, you specify if that extension should be installed and enabled locally or remotely.

Name: remote.forwardOnOpen
Desc: Controls whether local URLs with a port will be forwarded when opened from the terminal and the debug console.

Name: remote.localPortHost
Desc: Specifies the local host name that will be used for port forwarding.

Name: remote.otherPortsAttributes
Desc: Set default properties that are applied to all ports that don't get properties from the setting `remote.portsAttributes`. For example: "onAutoForward": "ignore"

Name: remote.portsAttributes
Desc: Set properties that are applied when a specific port number is forwarded. For example: "onAutoForward": "ignore" "onAutoForward": "openPreview"

Name: remote.restoreForwardedPorts
Desc: Restores the ports you forwarded in a workspace.

Name: remote.tunnels.access.hostNameOverride
Desc: The name under which the remote tunnel access is registered. If not set, the host name is used.

Name: remote.tunnels.access.preventSleep
Desc: Prevent this computer from sleeping when remote tunnel access is turned on.

Name: remote.tunnels.access.enableMicrosoftAuth
Desc: Enable Microsoft account authentication for agent host tunnels. When disabled, only GitHub authentication is used.

Name: scm.alwaysShowActions
Desc: Controls whether inline actions are always visible in the Source Control view.

Name: scm.alwaysShowRepositories
Desc: Controls whether repositories should always be visible in the Source Control view.

Name: scm.autoReveal
Desc: Controls whether the Source Control view should automatically reveal and select files when opening them.

Name: scm.compactFolders
Desc: Controls whether the Source Control view should render folders in a compact form. In such a form, single child folders will be compressed in a combined tree element.

Name: scm.countBadge
Desc: Controls the count badge on the Source Control icon on the Activity Bar. - all: Show the sum of all Source Control Provider count badges. - focused: Show the count badge of the focused Source Control Provider. - off: Disable the Source Control count badge.

Name: scm.defaultViewMode
Desc: Controls the default Source Control repository view mode. - tree: Show the repository changes as a tree. - list: Show the repository changes as a list.

Name: scm.defaultViewSortKey
Desc: Controls the default Source Control repository changes sort order when viewed as a list. - name: Sort the repository changes by file name. - path: Sort the repository changes by path. - status: Sort the repository changes by Source Control status.

Name: scm.diffDecorations
Desc: Controls diff decorations in the editor. - all: Show the diff decorations in all available locations. - gutter: Show the diff decorations only in the editor gutter. - overview: Show the diff decorations only in the overview ruler. - minimap: Show the diff decorations only in the minimap. - none: Do not show the diff decorations.

Name: scm.diffDecorationsGutterAction
Desc: Controls the behavior of Source Control diff gutter decorations. - diff: Show the inline diff Peek view on click. - none: Do nothing.

Name: scm.diffDecorationsGutterPattern
Desc: Controls whether a pattern is used for the diff decorations in gutter.

Name: scm.diffDecorationsGutterVisibility
Desc: Controls the visibility of the Source Control diff decorator in the gutter. - always: Show the diff decorator in the gutter at all times. - hover: Show the diff decorator in the gutter only on hover.

Name: scm.diffDecorationsGutterWidth
Desc: Controls the width(px) of diff decorations in gutter (added & modified).

Name: scm.diffDecorationsIgnoreTrimWhitespace
Desc: Controls whether leading and trailing whitespace is ignored in Source Control diff gutter decorations. - true: Ignore leading and trailing whitespace. - false: Do not ignore leading and trailing whitespace. - inherit: Inherit from `diffEditor.ignoreTrimWhitespace`.

Name: scm.graph.badges
Desc: Controls which badges are shown in the Source Control Graph view. The badges are shown on the right side of the graph indicating the names of history item groups. - all: Show badges of all history item groups in the Source Control Graph view. - filter: Show only the badges of history item groups used as a filter in the Source Control Graph view.

Name: scm.graph.pageOnScroll
Desc: Controls whether the Source Control Graph view will load the next page of items when you scroll to the end of the list.

Name: scm.graph.pageSize
Desc: The number of items to show in the Source Control Graph view by default and when loading more items.

Name: scm.graph.showIncomingChanges
Desc: Controls whether to show incoming changes in the Source Control Graph view.

Name: scm.graph.showOutgoingChanges
Desc: Controls whether to show outgoing changes in the Source Control Graph view.

Name: scm.inputFontFamily
Desc: Controls the font for the input message. Use `default` for the workbench user interface font family, `editor` for the `editor.fontFamily`'s value, or a custom font family.

Name: scm.inputFontSize
Desc: Controls the font size for the input message in pixels.

Name: scm.inputMaxLineCount
Desc: Controls the maximum number of lines that the input will auto-grow to.

Name: scm.inputMinLineCount
Desc: Controls the minimum number of lines that the input will auto-grow from.

Name: scm.providerCountBadge
Desc: Controls the count badges on Source Control Provider headers. These headers appear in the Source Control view when there is more than one provider or when the `scm.alwaysShowRepositories` setting is enabled, and in the Source Control Repositories view. - hidden: Hide Source Control Provider count badges. - auto: Only show count badge for Source Control Provider when non-zero. - visible: Show Source Control Provider count badges.

Name: scm.repositories.explorer
Desc: Controls whether to show repository artifacts in the Source Control Repositories view. This feature is experimental and only works when `scm.repositories.selectionMode` is set to `single`.

Name: scm.repositories.selectionMode
Desc: Controls the selection mode of the repositories in the Source Control Repositories view. - multiple: Multiple repositories can be selected at the same time. - single: Only one repository can be selected at a time.

Name: scm.repositories.sortOrder
Desc: Controls the sort order of the repositories in the source control repositories view. - discovery time: Repositories in the Source Control Repositories view are sorted by discovery time. Repositories in the Source Control view are sorted in the order that they were selected. - name: Repositories in the Source Control Repositories and Source Control views are sorted by repository name. - path: Repositories in the Source Control Repositories and Source Control views are sorted by repository path.

Name: scm.repositories.visible
Desc: Controls how many repositories are visible in the Source Control Repositories section. Set to 0, to be able to manually resize the view.

Name: scm.showActionButton
Desc: Controls whether an action button can be shown in the Source Control view.

Name: scm.showInputActionButton
Desc: Controls whether an action button can be shown in the Source Control input.

Name: scm.workingSets.default
Desc: Controls the default working set to use when switching to a source control history item group that does not have a working set. - empty: Use an empty working set when switching to a source control history item group that does not have a working set. - current: Use the current working set when switching to a source control history item group that does not have a working set.

Name: scm.workingSets.enabled
Desc: Controls whether to store editor working sets when switching between source control history item groups.

Name: screencastMode.fontSize
Desc: Controls the font size (in pixels) of the screencast mode keyboard.

Name: screencastMode.keyboardOptions
Desc: Options for customizing the keyboard overlay in screencast mode.

Name: screencastMode.keyboardOverlayTimeout
Desc: Controls how long (in milliseconds) the keyboard overlay is shown in screencast mode.

Name: screencastMode.mouseIndicatorColor
Desc: Controls the color in hex (#RGB, #RGBA, #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA) of the mouse indicator in screencast mode.

Name: screencastMode.mouseIndicatorSize
Desc: Controls the size (in pixels) of the mouse indicator in screencast mode.

Name: screencastMode.verticalOffset
Desc: Controls the vertical offset of the screencast mode overlay from the bottom as a percentage of the workbench height.

Name: scss.completion.completePropertyWithSemicolon
Desc: Insert semicolon at end of line when completing CSS properties.

Name: scss.completion.triggerPropertyValueCompletion
Desc: By default, VS Code triggers property value completion after selecting a CSS property. Use this setting to disable this behavior.

Name: scss.format.braceStyle
Desc: Put braces on the same line as rules (`collapse`) or put braces on own line (`expand`).

Name: scss.format.enable
Desc: Enable/disable default SCSS formatter.

Name: scss.format.maxPreserveNewLines
Desc: Maximum number of line breaks to be preserved in one chunk, when `scss.format.preserveNewLines` is enabled.

Name: scss.format.newlineBetweenRules
Desc: Separate rulesets by a blank line.

Name: scss.format.newlineBetweenSelectors
Desc: Separate selectors with a new line.

Name: scss.format.preserveNewLines
Desc: Whether existing line breaks before rules and declarations should be preserved.

Name: scss.format.spaceAroundSelectorSeparator
Desc: Ensure a space character around selector separators `>`, `+`, `~` (e.g. `a > b`).

Name: scss.hover.documentation
Desc: Show property and value documentation in SCSS hovers.

Name: scss.hover.references
Desc: Show references to MDN in SCSS hovers.

Name: scss.lint.argumentsInColorFunction
Desc: Invalid number of parameters.

Name: scss.lint.boxModel
Desc: Do not use `width` or `height` when using `padding` or `border`.

Name: scss.lint.compatibleVendorPrefixes
Desc: When using a vendor-specific prefix make sure to also include all other vendor-specific properties.

Name: scss.lint.duplicateProperties
Desc: Do not use duplicate style definitions.

Name: scss.lint.emptyRules
Desc: Do not use empty rulesets.

Name: scss.lint.float
Desc: Avoid using `float`. Floats lead to fragile CSS that is easy to break if one aspect of the layout changes.

Name: scss.lint.fontFaceProperties
Desc: `@font-face` rule must define `src` and `font-family` properties.

Name: scss.lint.hexColorLength
Desc: Hex colors must consist of 3, 4, 6 or 8 hex numbers.

Name: scss.lint.idSelector
Desc: Selectors should not contain IDs because these rules are too tightly coupled with the HTML.

Name: scss.lint.ieHack
Desc: IE hacks are only necessary when supporting IE7 and older.

Name: scss.lint.important
Desc: Avoid using `!important`. It is an indication that the specificity of the entire CSS has gotten out of control and needs to be refactored.

Name: scss.lint.importStatement
Desc: Import statements do not load in parallel.

Name: scss.lint.propertyIgnoredDueToDisplay
Desc: Property is ignored due to the display. E.g. with `display: inline`, the `width`, `height`, `margin-top`, `margin-bottom`, and `float` properties have no effect.

Name: scss.lint.universalSelector
Desc: The universal selector (`*`) is known to be slow.

Name: scss.lint.unknownAtRules
Desc: Unknown at-rule.

Name: scss.lint.unknownProperties
Desc: Unknown property.

Name: scss.lint.unknownVendorSpecificProperties
Desc: Unknown vendor specific property.

Name: scss.lint.validProperties
Desc: A list of properties that are not validated against the `unknownProperties` rule.

Name: scss.lint.vendorPrefix
Desc: When using a vendor-specific prefix, also include the standard property.

Name: scss.lint.zeroUnits
Desc: No unit for zero needed.

Name: scss.validate
Desc: Enables or disables all validations.

Name: search.actionsPosition
Desc: Controls the positioning of the actionbar on rows in the Search view. - auto: Position the actionbar to the right when the Search view is narrow, and immediately after the content when the Search view is wide. - right: Always position the actionbar to the right.

Name: search.collapseResults
Desc: Controls whether the search results will be collapsed or expanded. - auto: Files with less than 10 results are expanded. Others are collapsed. - alwaysCollapse - alwaysExpand

Name: search.decorations.badges
Desc: Controls whether search file decorations should use badges.

Name: search.decorations.colors
Desc: Controls whether search file decorations should use colors.

Name: search.defaultViewMode
Desc: Controls the default search result view mode. - tree: Shows search results as a tree. - list: Shows search results as a list.

Name: search.exclude
Desc: Configure [glob patterns](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/editor/codebasics#_advanced-search-options) for excluding files and folders in fulltext searches and file search in quick open. To exclude files from the recently opened list in quick open, patterns must be absolute (for example `**/node_modules/**`). Inherits all glob patterns from the `files.exclude` setting.

Name: search.experimental.closedNotebookRichContentResults
Desc: Show notebook editor rich content results for closed notebooks. Please refresh your search results after changing this setting.

Name: search.experimental.useIgnoreFilesInFindFiles
Desc: When enabled, the legacy `findFiles` extension API honors the user's `search.useIgnoreFiles` setting instead of always ignoring `.gitignore`. Extensions that explicitly pass `null` as the `exclude` argument still get unfiltered results. Telemetry is emitted regardless of this setting to help decide future defaults.

Name: search.followSymlinks
Desc: Controls whether to follow symlinks while searching.

Name: search.maxResults
Desc: Controls the maximum number of search results, this can be set to `null` (empty) to return unlimited results.

Name: search.mode
Desc: Controls where new `Search: Find in Files` and `Find in Folder` operations occur: either in the Search view, or in a search editor. - view: Search in the Search view, either in the panel or side bars. - reuseEditor: Search in an existing search editor if present, otherwise in a new search editor. - newEditor: Search in a new search editor.

Name: search.quickAccess.preserveInput
Desc: Controls whether the last typed input to Quick Search should be restored when opening it the next time.

Name: search.quickOpen.history.filterSortOrder
Desc: Controls sorting order of editor history in quick open when filtering. - default: History entries are sorted by relevance based on the filter value used. More relevant entries appear first. - recency: History entries are sorted by recency. More recently opened entries appear first.

Name: search.quickOpen.includeHistory
Desc: Whether to include results from recently opened files in the file results for Quick Open.

Name: search.quickOpen.includeSymbols
Desc: Whether to include results from a global symbol search in the file results for Quick Open.

Name: search.ripgrep.maxThreads
Desc: Number of threads to use for searching. When set to 0, the engine automatically determines this value.

Name: search.searchEditor.defaultNumberOfContextLines
Desc: The default number of surrounding context lines to use when creating new Search Editors. If using `search.searchEditor.reusePriorSearchConfiguration`, this can be set to `null` (empty) to use the prior Search Editor's configuration.

Name: search.searchEditor.doubleClickBehaviour
Desc: Configure effect of double-clicking a result in a search editor. - selectWord: Double-clicking selects the word under the cursor. - goToLocation: Double-clicking opens the result in the active editor group. - openLocationToSide: Double-clicking opens the result in the editor group to the side, creating one if it does not yet exist.

Name: search.searchEditor.focusResultsOnSearch
Desc: When a search is triggered, focus the Search Editor results instead of the Search Editor input.

Name: search.searchEditor.reusePriorSearchConfiguration
Desc: When enabled, new Search Editors will reuse the includes, excludes, and flags of the previously opened Search Editor.

Name: search.searchEditor.singleClickBehaviour
Desc: Configure effect of single-clicking a result in a search editor. - default: Single-clicking does nothing. - peekDefinition: Single-clicking opens a Peek Definition window.

Name: search.searchOnType
Desc: Search all files as you type.

Name: search.searchOnTypeDebouncePeriod
Desc: When `search.searchOnType` is enabled, controls the timeout in milliseconds between a character being typed and the search starting. Has no effect when `search.searchOnType` is disabled.

Name: search.searchView.keywordSuggestions
Desc: Enable keyword suggestions in the Search view.

Name: search.searchView.semanticSearchBehavior
Desc: Controls the behavior of the semantic search results displayed in the Search view. - manual: Only request semantic search results manually. - runOnEmpty: Request semantic results automatically only when text search results are empty. - auto: Request semantic results automatically with every search.

Name: search.seedOnFocus
Desc: Update the search query to the editor's selected text when focusing the Search view. This happens either on click or when triggering the `workbench.views.search.focus` command.

Name: search.seedWithNearestWord
Desc: Enable seeding search from the word nearest the cursor when the active editor has no selection.

Name: search.showLineNumbers
Desc: Controls whether to show line numbers for search results.

Name: search.smartCase
Desc: Search case-insensitively if the pattern is all lowercase, otherwise, search case-sensitively.

Name: search.sortOrder
Desc: Controls sorting order of search results. - default: Results are sorted by folder and file names, in alphabetical order. - fileNames: Results are sorted by file names ignoring folder order, in alphabetical order. - type: Results are sorted by file extensions, in alphabetical order. - modified: Results are sorted by file last modified date, in descending order. - countDescending: Results are sorted by count per file, in descending order. - countAscending: Results are sorted by count per file, in ascending order.

Name: search.useGlobalIgnoreFiles
Desc: Controls whether to use your global gitignore file (for example, from `$HOME/.config/git/ignore`) when searching for files. Requires `search.useIgnoreFiles` to be enabled.

Name: search.useIgnoreFiles
Desc: Controls whether to use `.gitignore` and `.ignore` files when searching for files.

Name: search.useParentIgnoreFiles
Desc: Controls whether to use `.gitignore` and `.ignore` files in parent directories when searching for files. Requires `search.useIgnoreFiles` to be enabled.

Name: search.useReplacePreview
Desc: Controls whether to open Replace Preview when selecting or replacing a match.

Name: security.promptForLocalFileProtocolHandling
Desc: If enabled, a dialog will ask for confirmation whenever a local file or workspace is about to open through a protocol handler.

Name: security.promptForRemoteFileProtocolHandling
Desc: If enabled, a dialog will ask for confirmation whenever a remote file or workspace is about to open through a protocol handler.

Name: security.workspace.trust.banner
Desc: Controls when the restricted mode banner is shown. - always: Show the banner every time an untrusted workspace is open. - untilDismissed: Show the banner when an untrusted workspace is opened until dismissed. - never: Do not show the banner when an untrusted workspace is open.

Name: security.workspace.trust.emptyWindow
Desc: Controls whether or not the empty window is trusted by default within VS Code. When used with `security.workspace.trust.untrustedFiles`, you can enable the full functionality of VS Code without prompting in an empty window.

Name: security.workspace.trust.enabled
Desc: Controls whether or not Workspace Trust is enabled within VS Code.

Name: security.workspace.trust.startupPrompt
Desc: Controls when the startup prompt to trust a workspace is shown. - always: Ask for trust every time an untrusted workspace is opened. - once: Ask for trust the first time an untrusted workspace is opened. - never: Do not ask for trust when an untrusted workspace is opened.

Name: security.workspace.trust.untrustedFiles
Desc: Controls how to handle opening untrusted files in a trusted workspace. This setting also applies to opening files in an empty window which is trusted via `security.workspace.trust.emptyWindow`. - prompt: Ask how to handle untrusted files for each workspace. Once untrusted files are introduced to a trusted workspace, you will not be prompted again. - open: Always allow untrusted files to be introduced to a trusted workspace without prompting. - newWindow: Always open untrusted files in a separate window in restricted mode without prompting.

Name: sessions.chatTimeline.display
Desc: Controls how the prompt timeline is displayed next to the chat transcript in the Agents window. - off: Do not show the prompt timeline. - ruler: Show an overview ruler beside the transcript scrollbar that fans into prompt pills on engagement. - gutter: Show a minimal handle in the transcript's left gutter that opens a list of prompts on hover.

Name: simpleBrowser.focusLockIndicator.enabled
Desc: Enable/disable the floating indicator that shows when focused in the simple browser.

Name: task.allowAutomaticTasks
Desc: Enable automatic tasks - note that tasks won't run in an untrusted workspace. - on: Always - off: Never

Name: task.autoDetect
Desc: Controls enablement of `provideTasks` for all task provider extension. If the Tasks: Run Task command is slow, disabling auto detect for task providers may help. Individual extensions may also provide settings that disable auto detection.

Name: task.notifyWindowOnTaskCompletion
Desc: Controls the minimum task runtime in milliseconds before showing an OS notification when the task finishes while the window is not in focus. Set to -1 to disable notifications. Set to 0 to always show notifications. This includes a window badge as well as notification toast.

Name: task.problemMatchers.neverPrompt
Desc: Configures whether to show the problem matcher prompt when running a task. Set to `true` to never prompt, or use a dictionary of task types to turn off prompting only for specific task types.

Name: task.quickOpen.detail
Desc: Controls whether to show the task detail for tasks that have a detail in task quick picks, such as Run Task.

Name: task.quickOpen.history
Desc: Controls the number of recent items tracked in task quick open dialog.

Name: task.quickOpen.showAll
Desc: Causes the Tasks: Run Task command to use the slower "show all" behavior instead of the faster two level picker where tasks are grouped by provider.

Name: task.quickOpen.skip
Desc: Controls whether the task quick pick is skipped when there is only one task to pick from.

Name: task.reconnection
Desc: On window reload, reconnect to tasks that have problem matchers.

Name: task.saveBeforeRun
Desc: Save all dirty editors before running a task. - always: Always saves all editors before running. - never: Never saves editors before running. - prompt: Prompts whether to save editors before running.

Name: task.slowProviderWarning
Desc: Configures whether a warning is shown when a provider is slow

Name: task.verboseLogging
Desc: Enable verbose logging for tasks.

Name: telemetry.editStats.details.enabled
Desc: Controls whether to enable telemetry for detailed edit statistics (only sends statistics if general telemetry is enabled).

Name: telemetry.editStats.enabled
Desc: Controls whether to enable telemetry for edit statistics (only sends statistics if general telemetry is enabled).

Name: telemetry.editStats.showDecorations
Desc: Controls whether to show decorations for edit telemetry.

Name: telemetry.editStats.showStatusBar
Desc: Controls whether to show the status bar for edit telemetry.

Name: telemetry.performance.inputLatencySamplingProbability
Desc: Probability (0 to 1) that input latency telemetry is reported for this session. Set to 0 to disable, 1 to always report.

Name: telemetry.enableCrashReporter
Desc: If this setting is false, no telemetry will be sent regardless of the new setting's value. Deprecated due to being combined into the `telemetry.telemetryLevel` setting. Enable crash reports to be collected. This helps us improve stability. This option requires restart to take effect.

Name: telemetry.enableTelemetry
Desc: If this setting is false, no telemetry will be sent regardless of the new setting's value. Deprecated in favor of the `telemetry.telemetryLevel` setting. Enable diagnostic data to be collected. This helps us to better understand how Visual Studio Code is performing and where improvements need to be made. [Read more](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkId=521839) about what we collect and our privacy statement.

Name: telemetry.feedback.enabled
Desc: Enable feedback mechanisms such as the issue reporter, surveys, and other feedback options.

Name: telemetry.telemetryLevel
Desc: Controls Visual Studio Code telemetry, first-party extension telemetry, and participating third-party extension telemetry. Some third party extensions might not respect this setting. Consult the specific extension's documentation to be sure. Telemetry helps us better understand how Visual Studio Code is performing, where improvements need to be made, and how features are being used. Read more about the [data we collect](https://aka.ms/vscode-telemetry) and our [privacy statement](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkId=521839). A full restart of the application is necessary for crash reporting changes to take effect. The following table outlines the data sent with each setting: |       | Crash Reports | Error Telemetry | Usage Data | |:------|:-------------:|:---------------:|:----------:| | all   |       ✓       |        ✓        |     ✓      | | error |       ✓       |        ✓        |     -      | | crash |       ✓       |        -        |     -      | | off   |       -       |        -        |     -      | ****Note:*** If this setting is 'off', no telemetry will be sent regardless of other telemetry settings. If this setting is set to anything except 'off' and telemetry is disabled with deprecated settings, no telemetry will be sent.* - all: Sends usage data, errors, and crash reports. - error: Sends general error telemetry and crash reports. - crash: Sends OS level crash reports. - off: Disables all product telemetry.

Name: terminal.integrated.accessibleViewFocusOnCommandExecution
Desc: Focus the terminal accessible view when a command is executed.

Name: terminal.integrated.accessibleViewPreserveCursorPosition
Desc: Controls whether the cursor position is preserved in the terminal's accessible view. - false: Always position the cursor at the bottom of the buffer. - true: Preserve the cursor position on reopen until new terminal content arrives. - always: Always preserve the cursor position, including when new terminal content arrives.

Name: terminal.integrated.agentHostProfile.linux
Desc: The terminal profile to use on Linux for agent host terminals, including shells launched by AI agent tools. Accepts either a profile name from `terminal.integrated.profiles.linux` or an inline profile object. When unset, falls back to `terminal.integrated.defaultProfile.linux`. Currently applies to the local agent host. Only the executable `path` is honored today; `args` and `env` from the profile are ignored. Remote agent hosts need remote-side shell configuration because local resolved paths may be invalid on the remote.

Name: terminal.integrated.agentHostProfile.osx
Desc: The terminal profile to use on macOS for agent host terminals, including shells launched by AI agent tools. Accepts either a profile name from `terminal.integrated.profiles.osx` or an inline profile object. When unset, falls back to `terminal.integrated.defaultProfile.osx`. Currently applies to the local agent host. Only the executable `path` is honored today; `args` and `env` from the profile are ignored. Remote agent hosts need remote-side shell configuration because local resolved paths may be invalid on the remote.

Name: terminal.integrated.agentHostProfile.windows
Desc: The terminal profile to use on Windows for agent host terminals, including shells launched by AI agent tools. Accepts either a profile name from `terminal.integrated.profiles.windows` or an inline profile object. When unset, falls back to `terminal.integrated.defaultProfile.windows`. Currently applies to the local agent host. Only the executable `path` is honored today; `args` and `env` from the profile are ignored. Remote agent hosts need remote-side shell configuration because local resolved paths may be invalid on the remote.

Name: terminal.integrated.allowChords
Desc: Whether or not to allow chord keybindings in the terminal. Note that when this is true and the keystroke results in a chord it will bypass `terminal.integrated.commandsToSkipShell`, setting this to false is particularly useful when you want ctrl+k to go to your shell (not VS Code).

Name: terminal.integrated.allowedLinkSchemes
Desc: An array of strings containing the URI schemes that the terminal is allowed to open links for. By default, only a small subset of possible schemes are allowed for security reasons.

Name: terminal.integrated.allowInUntrustedWorkspace
Desc: Controls whether terminals can be created in an untrusted workspace. **This feature bypasses a security protection that prevents terminals from launching in untrusted workspaces. The reason this is a security risk is because shells are often set up to potentially execute code automatically based on the contents of the current working directory. This should be safe to use provided your shell is set up in such a way that code execution in the folder never happens.**

Name: terminal.integrated.allowMnemonics
Desc: Whether to allow menubar mnemonics (for example Alt+F) to trigger the open of the menubar. Note that this will cause all alt keystrokes to skip the shell when true. This does nothing on macOS.

Name: terminal.integrated.altClickMovesCursor
Desc: If enabled, alt/option + click will reposition the prompt cursor to underneath the mouse when `editor.multiCursorModifier` is set to `'alt'` (the default value). This may not work reliably depending on your shell.

Name: terminal.integrated.automationProfile.linux
Desc: The terminal profile to use on Linux for automation-related terminal usage like tasks and debug.

Name: terminal.integrated.automationProfile.osx
Desc: The terminal profile to use on macOS for automation-related terminal usage like tasks and debug.

Name: terminal.integrated.automationProfile.windows
Desc: The terminal profile to use for automation-related terminal usage like tasks and debug. This setting will currently be ignored if `terminal.integrated.automationShell.windows` (now deprecated) is set.

Name: terminal.integrated.autoReplies
Desc: A set of messages that, when encountered in the terminal, will be automatically responded to. Provided the message is specific enough, this can help automate away common responses. - Use `"Terminate batch job (Y/N)": "Y\r"` to automatically respond to the terminate batch job prompt on Windows. - The message includes escape sequences so the reply might not happen with styled text. - Each reply can only happen once every second. - Use `"\r"` in the reply to mean the enter key. - To unset a default key, set the value to null. - Restart VS Code if new don't apply.

Name: terminal.integrated.bellDuration
Desc: The number of milliseconds to show the bell within a terminal tab when triggered.

Name: terminal.integrated.commandsToSkipShell
Desc: A set of command IDs whose keybindings will not be sent to the shell but instead always be handled by VS Code. This allows keybindings that would normally be consumed by the shell to act instead the same as when the terminal is not focused, for example `Ctrl+P` to launch Quick Open. Many commands are skipped by default. To override a default and pass that command's keybinding to the shell instead, add the command prefixed with the `-` character. For example add `-workbench.action.quickOpen` to allow `Ctrl+P` to reach the shell. The following list of default skipped commands is truncated when viewed in Settings Editor.
