Name: workbench.editor.closeEmptyGroups
Desc: Controls the behavior of empty editor groups when the last tab in the group is closed. When enabled, empty groups will automatically close. When disabled, empty groups will remain part of the grid.

Name: workbench.editor.closeOnFileDelete
Desc: Controls whether editors showing a file that was opened during the session should close automatically when getting deleted or renamed by some other process. Disabling this will keep the editor open  on such an event. Note that deleting from within the application will always close the editor and that editors with unsaved changes will never close to preserve your data.

Name: workbench.editor.customLabels.enabled
Desc: Controls whether the custom workbench editor labels should be applied.

Name: workbench.editor.customLabels.patterns
Desc: Controls the rendering of the editor label. Each __Item__ is a pattern that matches a file path. Both relative and absolute file paths are supported. The relative path must include the WORKSPACE_FOLDER (e.g `WORKSPACE_FOLDER/src/**.tsx` or `*/src/**.tsx`). Absolute patterns must start with a `/`. In case multiple patterns match, the longest matching path will be picked. Each __Value__ is the template for the rendered editor when the __Item__ matches. Variables are substituted based on the context: - `${dirname}`: name of the folder in which the file is located (e.g. `WORKSPACE_FOLDER/folder/file.txt -> folder`). - `${dirname(N)}`: name of the nth parent folder in which the file is located (e.g. `N=2: WORKSPACE_FOLDER/static/folder/file.txt -> WORKSPACE_FOLDER`). Folders can be picked from the start of the path by using negative numbers (e.g. `N=-1: WORKSPACE_FOLDER/folder/file.txt -> WORKSPACE_FOLDER`). If the __Item__ is an absolute pattern path, the first folder (`N=-1`) refers to the first folder in the absolute path, otherwise it corresponds to the workspace folder. - `${filename}`: name of the file without the file extension (e.g. `WORKSPACE_FOLDER/folder/file.txt -> file`). - `${extname}`: the file extension (e.g. `WORKSPACE_FOLDER/folder/file.txt -> txt`). - `${extname(N)}`: the nth extension of the file separated by '.' (e.g. `N=2: WORKSPACE_FOLDER/folder/file.ext1.ext2.ext3 -> ext1`). Extension can be picked from the start of the extension by using negative numbers (e.g. `N=-1: WORKSPACE_FOLDER/folder/file.ext1.ext2.ext3 -> ext2`). Example: `"**/static/**/*.html": "${filename} - ${dirname} (${extname})"` will render a file `WORKSPACE_FOLDER/static/folder/file.html` as `file - folder (html)`.

Name: workbench.editor.decorations.badges
Desc: Controls whether editor file decorations should use badges.

Name: workbench.editor.decorations.colors
Desc: Controls whether editor file decorations should use colors.

Name: workbench.editor.defaultBinaryEditor
Desc: The default editor for files detected as binary. If undefined, the user will be presented with a picker.

Name: workbench.editor.doubleClickTabToToggleEditorGroupSizes
Desc: Controls how the editor group is resized when double clicking on a tab. This value is ignored when `workbench.editor.showTabs` is not set to `multiple`. - maximize: All other editor groups are hidden and the current editor group is maximized to take up the entire editor area. - expand: The editor group takes as much space as possible by making all other editor groups as small as possible. - off: No editor group is resized when double clicking on a tab.

Name: workbench.editor.dragToOpenWindow
Desc: Controls if editors can be dragged out of the window to open them in a new window. Press and hold the `Alt` key while dragging to toggle this dynamically.

Name: workbench.editor.editorActionsLocation
Desc: Controls where the editor actions are shown. - default: Show editor actions in the window title bar when `workbench.editor.showTabs` is set to `none`. Otherwise, editor actions are shown in the editor tab bar. - titleBar: Show editor actions in the window title bar. If `window.customTitleBarVisibility` is set to `never`, editor actions are hidden. - hidden: Editor actions are not shown.

Name: workbench.editor.empty.hint
Desc: Controls if the empty editor text hint should be visible in the editor.

Name: workbench.editor.enablePreview
Desc: Controls whether preview mode is used when editors open. There is a maximum of one preview mode editor per editor group. This editor displays its filename in italics on its tab or title label and in the Open Editors view. Its contents will be replaced by the next editor opened in preview mode. Making a change in a preview mode editor will persist it, as will a double-click on its label, or the 'Keep Open' option in its label context menu. Opening a file from Explorer with a double-click persists its editor immediately.

Name: workbench.editor.enablePreviewFromCodeNavigation
Desc: Controls whether editors remain in preview when a code navigation is started from them. Preview editors do not stay open, and are reused until explicitly set to be kept open (via double-click or editing). This value is ignored when `workbench.editor.showTabs` is not set to `multiple`.

Name: workbench.editor.enablePreviewFromQuickOpen
Desc: Controls whether editors opened from Quick Open show as preview editors. Preview editors do not stay open, and are reused until explicitly set to be kept open (via double-click or editing). When enabled, hold Ctrl before selection to open an editor as a non-preview. This value is ignored when `workbench.editor.showTabs` is not set to `multiple`.

Name: workbench.editor.focusRecentEditorAfterClose
Desc: Controls whether editors are closed in most recently used order or from left to right.

Name: workbench.editor.hiddenEditorTypes
Desc: Configure editor types that are hidden from the editor type picker. The active editor type remains visible.

Name: workbench.editor.highlightModifiedTabs
Desc: Controls whether a top border is drawn on tabs for editors that have unsaved changes. This value is ignored when `workbench.editor.showTabs` is not set to multiple.

Name: workbench.editor.historyBasedLanguageDetection
Desc: Enables use of editor history in language detection. This causes automatic language detection to favor languages that have been recently opened and allows for automatic language detection to operate with smaller inputs.

Name: workbench.editor.labelFormat
Desc: Controls the format of the label for an editor. - default: Show the name of the file. When tabs are enabled and two files have the same name in one group the distinguishing sections of each file's path are added. When tabs are disabled, the path relative to the workspace folder is shown if the editor is active. - short: Show the name of the file followed by its directory name. - medium: Show the name of the file followed by its path relative to the workspace folder. - long: Show the name of the file followed by its absolute path.

Name: workbench.editor.languageDetection
Desc: Controls whether the language in a text editor is automatically detected unless the language has been explicitly set by the language picker. This can also be scoped by language so you can specify which languages you do not want to be switched off of. This is useful for languages like Markdown that often contain other languages that might trick language detection into thinking it's the embedded language and not Markdown.

Name: workbench.editor.languageDetectionHints
Desc: When enabled, shows a status bar Quick Fix when the editor language doesn't match detected content language.

Name: workbench.editor.limit.enabled
Desc: Controls if the number of opened editors should be limited or not. When enabled, less recently used editors will close to make space for newly opening editors.

Name: workbench.editor.limit.excludeDirty
Desc: Controls if the maximum number of opened editors should exclude dirty editors for counting towards the configured limit.

Name: workbench.editor.limit.perEditorGroup
Desc: Controls if the limit of maximum opened editors should apply per editor group or across all editor groups.

Name: workbench.editor.limit.value
Desc: Controls the maximum number of opened editors. Use the `workbench.editor.limit.perEditorGroup` setting to control this limit per editor group or across all groups.

Name: workbench.editor.markdownDefaultEditorInAgentsWindow
Desc: Controls whether the Markdown editor is used as the default editor for Markdown files in the Agents window.

Name: workbench.editor.mouseBackForwardToNavigate
Desc: Enables the use of mouse buttons four and five for commands 'Go Back' and 'Go Forward'.

Name: workbench.editor.navigationScope
Desc: Controls the scope of history navigation in editors for commands such as 'Go Back' and 'Go Forward'. - default: Navigate across all opened editors and editor groups. - editorGroup: Navigate only in editors of the active editor group. - editor: Navigate only in the active editor.

Name: workbench.editor.openPositioning
Desc: Controls where editors open. Select `left` or `right` to open editors to the left or right of the currently active one. Select `first` or `last` to open editors independently from the currently active one.

Name: workbench.editor.openSideBySideDirection
Desc: Controls the default direction of editors that are opened side by side (for example, from the Explorer). By default, editors will open on the right hand side of the currently active one. If changed to `down`, the editors will open below the currently active one. This also impacts the split editor action in the editor toolbar.

Name: workbench.editor.pinnedTabSizing
Desc: Controls the size of pinned editor tabs. Pinned tabs are sorted to the beginning of all opened tabs and typically do not close until unpinned. This value is ignored when `workbench.editor.showTabs` is not set to `multiple`. - normal: A pinned tab inherits the look of non pinned tabs. - compact: A pinned tab will show in a compact form with only icon or first letter of the editor name. - shrink: A pinned tab shrinks to a compact fixed size showing parts of the editor name.

Name: workbench.editor.pinnedTabsOnSeparateRow
Desc: When enabled, displays pinned tabs in a separate row above all other tabs. This value is ignored when `workbench.editor.showTabs` is not set to `multiple`.

Name: workbench.editor.preferHistoryBasedLanguageDetection
Desc: When enabled, a language detection model that takes into account editor history will be given higher precedence.

Name: workbench.editor.preventPinnedEditorClose
Desc: Controls whether pinned editors should close when keyboard or middle mouse click is used for closing. - keyboardAndMouse: Always prevent closing the pinned editor when using mouse middle click or keyboard. - keyboard: Prevent closing the pinned editor when using the keyboard. - mouse: Prevent closing the pinned editor when using mouse middle click. - never: Never prevent closing a pinned editor.

Name: workbench.editor.restoreEditors
Desc: Controls whether editors are restored on startup. When disabled, only dirty editors will be restored from the previous session.

Name: workbench.editor.restoreViewState
Desc: Restores the last editor view state (such as scroll position) when re-opening editors after they have been closed. Editor view state is stored per editor group and discarded when a group closes. Use the `workbench.editor.sharedViewState` setting to use the last known view state across all editor groups in case no previous view state was found for a editor group.

Name: workbench.editor.revealIfOpen
Desc: Controls whether an editor is revealed in any of the visible groups if opened. If disabled, an editor will prefer to open in the currently active editor group. If enabled, an already opened editor will be revealed instead of opened again in the currently active editor group. Note that there are some cases where this setting is ignored, such as when forcing an editor to open in a specific group or to the side of the currently active group.

Name: workbench.editor.scrollToSwitchTabs
Desc: Controls whether scrolling over tabs will open them or not. By default tabs will only reveal upon scrolling, but not open. You can press and hold the Shift-key while scrolling to change this behavior for that duration. This value is ignored when `workbench.editor.showTabs` is not set to `multiple`.

Name: workbench.editor.sharedViewState
Desc: Preserves the most recent editor view state (such as scroll position) across all editor groups and restores that if no specific editor view state is found for the editor group.

Name: workbench.editor.showIcons
Desc: Controls whether opened editors should show with an icon or not. This requires a file icon theme to be enabled as well.

Name: workbench.editor.showTabIndex
Desc: When enabled, will show the tab index. This value is ignored when `workbench.editor.showTabs` is not set to `multiple`.

Name: workbench.editor.showTabs
Desc: Controls whether opened editors should show as individual tabs, one single large tab or if the title area should not be shown. - multiple: Each editor is displayed as a tab in the editor title area. - single: The active editor is displayed as a single large tab in the editor title area. - none: The editor title area is not displayed.

Name: workbench.editor.splitInGroupLayout
Desc: Controls the layout for when an editor is split in an editor group to be either vertical or horizontal. - vertical: Editors are positioned from top to bottom. - horizontal: Editors are positioned from left to right.

Name: workbench.editor.splitOnDragAndDrop
Desc: Controls if editor groups can be split from drag and drop operations by dropping an editor or file on the edges of the editor area.

Name: workbench.editor.splitSizing
Desc: Controls the size of editor groups when splitting them. - auto: Splits the active editor group to equal parts, unless all editor groups are already in equal parts. In that case, splits all the editor groups to equal parts. - distribute: Splits all the editor groups to equal parts. - split: Splits the active editor group to equal parts.

Name: workbench.editor.tabActionCloseVisibility
Desc: Controls the visibility of the tab close action button.

Name: workbench.editor.tabActionLocation
Desc: Controls the position of the editor's tabs action buttons (close, unpin). This value is ignored when `workbench.editor.showTabs` is not set to `multiple`.

Name: workbench.editor.tabActionReserveSpace
Desc: Controls whether Modern UI editor tabs always reserve space for tab action buttons. When disabled, clean tabs stay compact; tabs with persistent dirty or pinned indicators reserve space regardless.

Name: workbench.editor.tabActionUnpinVisibility
Desc: Controls the visibility of the tab unpin action button.

Name: workbench.editor.tabSizing
Desc: Controls the size of editor tabs. This value is ignored when `workbench.editor.showTabs` is not set to `multiple`. - fit: Always keep tabs large enough to show the full editor label. - shrink: Allow tabs to get smaller when the available space is not enough to show all tabs at once. - fixed: Make all tabs the same size, while allowing them to get smaller when the available space is not enough to show all tabs at once.

Name: workbench.editor.tabSizingFixedMaxWidth
Desc: Controls the maximum width of tabs when `workbench.editor.tabSizing` size is set to `fixed`.

Name: workbench.editor.tabSizingFixedMinWidth
Desc: Controls the minimum width of tabs when `workbench.editor.tabSizing` size is set to `fixed`.

Name: workbench.editor.titleScrollbarSizing
Desc: Controls the height of the scrollbars used for tabs and breadcrumbs in the editor title area. - default: The default size. - large: Increases the size, so it can be grabbed more easily with the mouse.

Name: workbench.editor.titleScrollbarVisibility
Desc: Controls the visibility of the scrollbars used for tabs and breadcrumbs in the editor title area. - auto: The horizontal scrollbar will be visible only when necessary. - visible: The horizontal scrollbar will always be visible. - hidden: The horizontal scrollbar will always be hidden.

Name: workbench.editor.untitled.labelFormat
Desc: Controls the format of the label for an untitled editor. - content: The name of the untitled file is derived from the contents of its first line unless it has an associated file path. It will fallback to the name in case the line is empty or contains no word characters. - name: The name of the untitled file is not derived from the contents of the file.

Name: workbench.editor.useModal
Desc: Controls whether editors open in a modal overlay. - off: Editors never open in a modal overlay. - some: Certain editors such as Settings and Keyboard Shortcuts may open in a centered modal overlay. - all: All editors open in a centered modal overlay.

Name: workbench.editor.wrapTabs
Desc: Controls whether tabs should be wrapped over multiple lines when exceeding available space or whether a scrollbar should appear instead. This value is ignored when `workbench.editor.showTabs` is not set to '`multiple`'.

Name: workbench.editorAssociations
Desc: Configure [glob patterns](https://aka.ms/vscode-glob-patterns) to editors (for example `"*.hex": "hexEditor.hexedit"`). These have precedence over the default behavior.

Name: workbench.editorLargeFileConfirmation
Desc: Controls the minimum size of a file in MB before asking for confirmation when opening in the editor. Note that this setting may not apply to all editor types and environments.

Name: workbench.enableExperiments
Desc: Fetches experiments to run from a Microsoft online service.

Name: workbench.experimental.cloudChanges.autoStore
Desc: Controls whether to automatically store available working changes in the cloud for the current workspace. This setting has no effect in the web. - onShutdown: Automatically store current working changes in the cloud on window close. - off: Never attempt to automatically store working changes in the cloud.

Name: workbench.experimental.cloudChanges.partialMatches.enabled
Desc: Controls whether to surface cloud changes which partially match the current session.

Name: workbench.experimental.modernUI
Desc: Controls whether the Modern UI Update is enabled. When on, the side bars and bottom panel are shown as floating cards with rounded corners and gaps, and a set of refreshed workbench styles is applied, matching the Agents window design.

Name: workbench.experimental.modernUIUppercaseViewHeaders
Desc: Controls whether view headers, side bar titles, and panel tabs use uppercase text when `workbench.experimental.modernUI` is enabled.

Name: workbench.experimental.share.enabled
Desc: Controls whether to render the Share action next to the command center when `window.commandCenter` is `true`.

Name: workbench.externalBrowser
Desc: Configure the browser to use for opening http or https links externally. This can either be the name of the browser (`edge`, `chrome`, `firefox`) or an absolute path to the browser's executable. Will use the system default if not set.

Name: workbench.externalUriOpeners
Desc: Configure the opener to use for external URIs (http, https).

Name: workbench.hover.delay
Desc: Controls the delay in milliseconds after which the hover is shown for workbench items (ex. some extension provided tree view items). Already visible items may require a refresh before reflecting this setting change.

Name: workbench.hover.reducedDelay
Desc: Controls the reduced delay in milliseconds used for showing hovers in specific contexts where faster feedback is beneficial.

Name: workbench.layoutControl.enabled
Desc: Controls whether the layout control is shown in the custom title bar. This setting only has an effect when `window.customTitleBarVisibility` is not set to `never`.

Name: workbench.layoutControl.type
Desc: Controls whether the layout control in the custom title bar is displayed as a single menu button or with multiple UI toggles. - menu: Shows a single button with a dropdown of layout options. - toggles: Shows several buttons for toggling the visibility of the panels and side bar. - both: Shows both the dropdown and toggle buttons.

Name: workbench.list.defaultFindMatchType
Desc: Controls the type of matching used when searching lists and trees in the workbench. - fuzzy: Use fuzzy matching when searching. - contiguous: Use contiguous matching when searching.

Name: workbench.list.defaultFindMode
Desc: Controls the default find mode for lists and trees in the workbench. - highlight: Highlight elements when searching. Further up and down navigation will traverse only the highlighted elements. - filter: Filter elements when searching.

Name: workbench.list.fastScrollSensitivity
Desc: Scrolling speed multiplier when pressing `Alt`.

Name: workbench.list.horizontalScrolling
Desc: Controls whether lists and trees support horizontal scrolling in the workbench. Warning: turning on this setting has a performance implication.

Name: workbench.list.keyboardNavigation
Desc: Please use 'workbench.list.defaultFindMode' and	'workbench.list.typeNavigationMode' instead. Controls the keyboard navigation style for lists and trees in the workbench. Can be simple, highlight and filter. - simple: Simple keyboard navigation focuses elements which match the keyboard input. Matching is done only on prefixes. - highlight: Highlight keyboard navigation highlights elements which match the keyboard input. Further up and down navigation will traverse only the highlighted elements. - filter: Filter keyboard navigation will filter out and hide all the elements which do not match the keyboard input.

Name: workbench.list.mouseWheelScrollSensitivity
Desc: A multiplier to be used on the `deltaX` and `deltaY` of mouse wheel scroll events.

Name: workbench.list.multiSelectModifier
Desc: The modifier to be used to add an item in trees and lists to a multi-selection with the mouse (for example in the explorer, open editors and scm view). The 'Open to Side' mouse gestures - if supported - will adapt such that they do not conflict with the multiselect modifier. - ctrlCmd: Maps to `Control` on Windows and Linux and to `Command` on macOS. - alt: Maps to `Alt` on Windows and Linux and to `Option` on macOS.

Name: workbench.list.openMode
Desc: Controls how to open items in trees and lists using the mouse (if supported). Note that some trees and lists might choose to ignore this setting if it is not applicable.

Name: workbench.list.scrollByPage
Desc: Controls whether clicks in the scrollbar scroll page by page.

Name: workbench.list.smoothScrolling
Desc: Controls whether lists and trees have smooth scrolling.

Name: workbench.list.typeNavigationMode
Desc: Controls how type navigation works in lists and trees in the workbench. When set to `trigger`, type navigation begins once the `list.triggerTypeNavigation` command is run.

Name: workbench.localHistory.enabled
Desc: Controls whether local file history is enabled. When enabled, the file contents of an editor that is saved will be stored to a backup location to be able to restore or review the contents later. Changing this setting has no effect on existing local file history entries.

Name: workbench.localHistory.exclude
Desc: Configure paths or [glob patterns](https://aka.ms/vscode-glob-patterns) for excluding files from the local file history. Glob patterns are always evaluated relative to the path of the workspace folder unless they are absolute paths. Changing this setting has no effect on existing local file history entries.

Name: workbench.localHistory.maxFileEntries
Desc: Controls the maximum number of local file history entries per file. When the number of local file history entries exceeds this number for a file, the oldest entries will be discarded.

Name: workbench.localHistory.maxFileSize
Desc: Controls the maximum size of a file (in KB) to be considered for local file history. Files that are larger will not be added to the local file history. Changing this setting has no effect on existing local file history entries.

Name: workbench.localHistory.mergeWindow
Desc: Configure an interval in seconds during which the last entry in local file history is replaced with the entry that is being added. This helps reduce the overall number of entries that are added, for example when auto save is enabled. This setting is only applied to entries that have the same source of origin. Changing this setting has no effect on existing local file history entries.

Name: workbench.navigationControl.enabled
Desc: Controls whether the navigation control is shown in the custom title bar. This setting only has an effect when `window.customTitleBarVisibility` is not set to `never`.

Name: workbench.notifications.position
Desc: Controls the position of the notification toasts and notification center. - bottom-right: Show notifications in the bottom right corner. - bottom-left: Show notifications in the bottom left corner. - top-right: Show notifications in the top right corner, similar to OS-level notifications.

Name: workbench.notifications.showInTitleBar
Desc: Controls the visibility of the Notifications button in the title bar. Only applies when notifications are positioned at the top right.

Name: workbench.panel.defaultLocation
Desc: Controls the default location of the panel (Terminal, Debug Console, Output, Problems) in a new workspace. It can either show at the bottom, top, right, or left of the editor area.

Name: workbench.panel.opensMaximized
Desc: Controls whether the panel opens maximized. It can either always open maximized, never open maximized, or open to the last state it was in before being closed. - always: Always maximize the panel when opening it. - never: Never maximize the panel when opening it. - preserve: Open the panel to the state that it was in, before it was closed.

Name: workbench.panel.showLabels
Desc: Controls whether activity items in the panel title are shown as label or icon.

Name: workbench.quickOpen.closeOnFocusLost
Desc: Controls whether Quick Open should close automatically once it loses focus.

Name: workbench.quickOpen.preserveInput
Desc: Controls whether the last typed input to Quick Open should be restored when opening it the next time.

Name: workbench.reduceMotion
Desc: Controls whether the workbench should render with fewer animations. - on: Always render with reduced motion. - off: Do not render with reduced motion - auto: Render with reduced motion based on OS configuration.

Name: workbench.reduceTransparency
Desc: Controls whether the workbench should render with fewer transparency and blur effects for improved performance. - on: Always render without transparency and blur effects. - off: Do not reduce transparency and blur effects. - auto: Reduce transparency and blur effects based on OS configuration.

Name: workbench.remoteIndicator.showExtensionRecommendations
Desc: When enabled, remote extensions recommendations will be shown in the Remote Indicator menu.

Name: workbench.sash.hoverDelay
Desc: Controls the hover feedback delay in milliseconds of the dragging area in between views/editors.

Name: workbench.sash.size
Desc: Controls the feedback area size in pixels of the dragging area in between views/editors. Set it to a larger value if you feel it's hard to resize views using the mouse.

Name: workbench.secondarySideBar.defaultVisibility
Desc: Controls the default visibility of the secondary side bar in workspaces or empty windows that are opened for the first time. Can be overridden by the agent sessions startup editor setting. - hidden: The secondary side bar is hidden by default. - visibleInWorkspace: The secondary side bar is visible by default if a workspace is opened. - visible: The secondary side bar is visible by default. - maximizedInWorkspace: The secondary side bar is visible and maximized by default if a workspace is opened. - maximized: The secondary side bar is visible and maximized by default.

Name: workbench.secondarySideBar.forceMaximized
Desc: Controls whether the secondary side bar is enforced to always show maximized on startup and when there are no open editors, in layouts that support a maximized secondary side bar.

Name: workbench.secondarySideBar.showLabels
Desc: Controls whether activity items in the secondary side bar title are shown as label or icon. This setting only has an effect when `workbench.activityBar.location` is not set to `top`.

Name: workbench.settings.alwaysShowAdvancedSettings
Desc: Controls whether advanced settings are always shown in the settings editor without requiring the `@tag:advanced` filter.

Name: workbench.settings.applyToAllProfiles
Desc: Configure settings to be applied for all profiles.

Name: workbench.settings.editor
Desc: Determines which Settings editor to use by default. - ui: Use the settings UI editor. - json: Use the JSON file editor.

Name: workbench.settings.enableNaturalLanguageSearch
Desc: Controls whether to enable the natural language search mode for settings. The natural language search is provided by a Microsoft online service.

Name: workbench.settings.openDefaultKeybindings
Desc: Controls whether opening keybinding settings also opens an editor showing all default keybindings.

Name: workbench.settings.openDefaultSettings
Desc: Controls whether opening settings also opens an editor showing all default settings.

Name: workbench.settings.settingsSearchTocBehavior
Desc: Controls the behavior of the Settings editor Table of Contents while searching. If this setting is being changed in the Settings editor, the setting will take effect after the search query is modified. - hide: Hide the Table of Contents while searching. - filter: Filter the Table of Contents to just categories that have matching settings. Clicking on a category will filter the results to that category.

Name: workbench.settings.showAISearchToggle
Desc: Controls whether the AI search results toggle is shown in the search bar in the Settings editor after doing a search and once AI search results are available.

Name: workbench.settings.useSplitJSON
Desc: Controls whether to use the split JSON editor when editing settings as JSON.

Name: workbench.shadows
Desc: Controls whether shadow effects are shown around the side panels and other workbench elements.

Name: workbench.sideBar.location
Desc: Controls the location of the primary side bar and activity bar. They can either show on the left or right of the workbench. The secondary side bar will show on the opposite side of the workbench.

Name: workbench.startupEditor
Desc: Controls which editor is shown at startup, if none are restored from the previous session. - none: Start without an editor. - welcomePage: Open the Welcome page, with content to aid in getting started with VS Code and extensions. - readme: Open the README when opening a folder that contains one, fallback to 'welcomePage' otherwise. Note: This is only observed as a global configuration, it will be ignored if set in a workspace or folder configuration. - newUntitledFile: Open a new untitled text file (only applies when opening an empty window). - welcomePageInEmptyWorkbench: Open the Welcome page when opening an empty workbench. - terminal: Open a new terminal in the editor area. - agentSessionsWelcomePage: Open the Agent Sessions Welcome page. Will override the workbench secondary side bar visibility settings.

Name: workbench.statusBar.visible
Desc: Controls the visibility of the status bar at the bottom of the workbench.

Name: workbench.tips.enabled
Desc: When enabled, will show the watermark tips when no editor is open.

Name: workbench.tree.enableStickyScroll
Desc: Controls whether sticky scrolling is enabled in trees.

Name: workbench.tree.expandMode
Desc: Controls how tree folders are expanded when clicking the folder names. Note that some trees and lists might choose to ignore this setting if it is not applicable.

Name: workbench.tree.indent
Desc: Controls tree indentation in pixels.

Name: workbench.tree.renderIndentGuides
Desc: Controls whether the tree should render indent guides.

Name: workbench.tree.stickyScrollMaxItemCount
Desc: Controls the number of sticky elements displayed in the tree when `workbench.tree.enableStickyScroll` is enabled.

Name: workbench.trustedDomains.promptInTrustedWorkspace
Desc: When enabled, trusted domain prompts will appear when opening links in trusted workspaces.

Name: workbench.view.alwaysShowHeaderActions
Desc: Controls the visibility of view header actions. View header actions may either be always visible, or only visible when that view is focused or hovered over.

Name: workbench.view.showQuietly
Desc: If an extension requests a hidden view to be shown, display a clickable status bar indicator instead.

Name: workbench.welcomePage.experimentalOnboarding
Desc: When enabled, show the new onboarding experience instead of the classic walkthrough on first launch.

Name: workbench.welcomePage.preferReducedMotion
Desc: Deprecated, use the global `workbench.reduceMotion`. When enabled, reduce motion in welcome page.

Name: workbench.welcomePage.walkthroughs.openOnInstall
Desc: When enabled, an extension's walkthrough will open upon install of the extension.

Name: workbench.colorCustomizations
Desc: Overrides colors from the currently selected color theme.

Name: workbench.colorTheme
Desc: Specifies the color theme used in the workbench when `window.autoDetectColorScheme` is not enabled.

Name: workbench.iconTheme
Desc: Specifies the file icon theme used in the workbench or 'null' to not show any file icons. - null: No file icons - vs-minimal - vscode-modern-icons - vs-seti

Name: workbench.preferredDarkColorTheme
Desc: Specifies the color theme when system color mode is dark and `window.autoDetectColorScheme` is enabled.

Name: workbench.preferredHighContrastColorTheme
Desc: Specifies the color theme when in high contrast dark mode and `window.autoDetectHighContrast` is enabled.

Name: workbench.preferredHighContrastLightColorTheme
Desc: Specifies the color theme when in high contrast light mode and `window.autoDetectHighContrast` is enabled.

Name: workbench.preferredLightColorTheme
Desc: Specifies the color theme when system color mode is light and `window.autoDetectColorScheme` is enabled.

Name: workbench.productIconTheme
Desc: Specifies the product icon theme used. - Default: Default

Name: zenMode.centerLayout
Desc: Controls whether turning on Zen Mode also centers the layout.

Name: zenMode.fullScreen
Desc: Controls whether turning on Zen Mode also puts the workbench into full screen mode.

Name: zenMode.hideActivityBar
Desc: Controls whether turning on Zen Mode also hides the activity bar either at the left or right of the workbench.

Name: zenMode.hideLineNumbers
Desc: Controls whether turning on Zen Mode also hides the editor line numbers.

Name: zenMode.hideStatusBar
Desc: Controls whether turning on Zen Mode also hides the status bar at the bottom of the workbench.

Name: zenMode.restore
Desc: Controls whether a window should restore to Zen Mode if it was exited in Zen Mode.

Name: zenMode.showTabs
Desc: Controls whether turning on Zen Mode should show multiple editor tabs, a single editor tab, or hide the editor title area completely. - multiple: Each editor is displayed as a tab in the editor title area. - single: The active editor is displayed as a single large tab in the editor title area. - none: The editor title area is not displayed.

Name: zenMode.silentNotifications
Desc: Controls whether notifications do not disturb mode should be enabled while in Zen Mode. If true, only error notifications will pop out.
